chapters.title: Chapter 152 - Immortal Qi Crystal
paragraphs: Qingyi entered a large hall, his eyes studying the walls molded with golden dragons.
He stopped his steps, raising his head.
At the end of the hall, he saw a figure he knew well.
A man with beautiful but aged features, sitting on a throne that seemed to be made of pure jade.
It was Jinhai, the leader of the Ascending Dragon sect.
"Disciple Long Qingyi greets the sect leader!" Qingyi bowed respectfully, drawing a smile from Jinhai.
But that smile didn’t last long.
"Juechen told me about your achievements.

Defeating a demonic cultivator from the Iron Body realm while only being at the Golden Core realm is no small feat, even if it’s using an offensive artifact with your master’s Qi." Jinhai said, standing up.
"But he also told me about true demons. Tell me, how do you know about true demons? Did the demon cultivator say anything about them before he died?"

"Well... Yes, sect leader, it was my old master who taught me about true demons, inhuman beings who only inhabit the heavenly sky. The old woman mentioned something about summoning one of those." Qingyi replied, not having much choice but to lie.
"I see..." Jinhai scratched his chin thoughtfully.
The existence of true demons wasn’t something just any disciple should have known.
In fact, not even he should be aware of such things.
Even in the Nine Peaks Basin, such knowledge was very restricted. Even so, it wasn’t exactly forbidden knowledge, just something that wasn’t taught.
"Do you have anything else to report?" He asked, looking deeply into the handsome young man’s eyes.
Qingyi just shook his head. "No, sect master, that’s all I know."
"Ah..." Jinhai sighed heavily before returning to his throne.
He looked at the man who had brought Qingyi to the palace and after thinking for a moment, made his decision.
"Long Qingyi, as a core disciple, you have completed an extremely difficult and important mission, saving thousands of lives, including that of my direct disciple, Juechen." Jinhai declared.
"As a reward for your display of courage and talent, I will give you access to the sect’s vault. You may take a single item from there, any item."
Those words made the man behind Qingyi shudder.
His eyes widened as he took a step forward.
"My lord, please reconsider! There are too many priceless treasures, we can’t risk it-"
"I’ve already made up my mind, these treasures are worthless if they’re left to rot on a shelf for the rest of eternity." Jinhai interrupted, focusing his gaze on Qingyi again.
"This is Luo Haoran, my personal servant. He will guide you to the sect vault to choose your reward."
Qingyi turned around, looking at the man who had accompanied him into the palace.
"Greetings, Senior Luo Haoran." Qingyi bowed to the man, who just gritted his teeth.
He didn’t want to do that, but the sect leader’s words were orders.
"Come with me." Haoran spoke and together with Qingyi, they went further into the sect leader’s palace, descending for long minutes until they finally reached a black steel door.
"This is the sect’s vault. It’s protected by undetectable formations that are so powerful that even an expert of the Crystal Core realm could die if they tried to break through them by force.

Normally the sect leader and the head finance elder would be the only ones to have access to the vault, but thanks to my two hundred and fifty years of loyal work, the leader has allowed me to help him manage the sect’s wealth."
Haoran tapped on the vault door, his voice brimming with pride as he pushed his Qi towards it.
With a soft click, the steel door slowly opened, revealing the interior to Qingyi.
The handsome young man couldn’t help but gasp.
The vault was like any other warehouse room, but with one difference.
Its steel walls stood more than 50 meters high and stretched for hundreds of meters.
There were thousands of weapons, some reaching Epic grade and even one or two at Legendary grade, with shelves and shelves full of forging, alchemy and cultivation materials.
It really was a paradise, riches accumulated over thousands of years since the founding of the sect.
"The vault is full of detection formations. If you take more than one item, the punishment will be severe," Haoran warned.
"Thank you, senior." Qingyi nodded as he made his way through the aisles of shelves, his attentive eyes studying everything.
Honestly, he couldn’t help feeling a little indecisive.
Even if only 0.01% of the items were good options, this 0.01% still represented dozens of items to consider.
’Ruxue, you can see through my eyes, right?’ He called out in his mind.
’I can see everything you see,’ she replied.
"Can you see anything interesting?"
"Hmm..." Ruxue seemed to think for a moment before finally speaking. "Everything here is absolute garbage, just take anything."
’Ah... of course. Qingyi smiled bitterly.
What in this place could impress an entity that came from the heavenly sky?

Even though she had lived in the mortal sky for thousands of years, these had been spent alongside a Transcendence realm cultivator, and even the lowest level resources she had access to were infinitely superior to those here.
Qingyi continued walking through the vault, his interest slowly fading.
"This..." Qingyi suddenly stopped, his eyes focusing on an item.
It was just an ordinary white stone a little larger than his fist.
’System, can I see the information on this item?’
[Item: Exhausted immortal Qi crystal
Description: An ancient and long-exhausted Qi crystal can have its energy restored by inferior Qi crystals, serving as fuel for various applications and spiritual formations.
Grade: Epic]
"Ruxue, your mind world only needs one source of energy to be stable and support more people at the same time, right? Ordinary Qi crystals will work?"

"They could work... but the crystals in this place aren’t usually ready to work with the formations that keep my world of mind going, we’d need a higher-level crystal and-" Ruxue suddenly stopped talking.
"What did you see in that stone?" She asked, her sweet, mature voice full of suspicion.
"You’ll see." Qingyi laughed softly.
If that crystal worked as he imagined, it could solve many of his worries.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - That’s the bastard I was talking about!
paragraphs: As she boarded the flying ship with her mistress, Qingyi’s eyes quickly caught sight of a tanned beauty sitting on a bench in a corner of the ship.
"Husband!" Feiyan waved to him, her bountiful breasts almost jutting out of her cleavage as she stood up excitedly.
Walking over to Qingyi, she immediately pulled him against her, sinking his arm into the warm, soft embrace of her huge twin mountains.
"Do you have any idea how much I’ve missed you? You’ll have to repay me handsomely for that..." She purred in his ear, her sweet, sensual, breathy voice causing the handsome young man to shiver.
Qingxue, who was standing next to them, shuddered softly.
Her face flushed as she made her way towards the front of the flying ship.
As an elder, she naturally had her own room, unlike the disciples who had to sit on uncomfortable benches during the journey.
"Have you made any breakthroughs?" Qingyi asked, sensing that Feiyan’s aura was much deeper than before.
She was at least at the third stage of the Golden Core realm.
"Two, actually." Feiyan flashed a broad smile as she sat down with him on one of the seats in the flying ship.
"Not that it’s much compared to you, I still have to work hard to be useful to the husband." She whispered, barely able to sense Qingyi’s Qi.
Qingyi had to stop himself from lifting up Feiyan’s fat, juicy ass and spanking her in front of everyone there.
Was that woman having self-esteem problems now?
"I wouldn’t be able to advance this far if it weren’t for you spoiling me with your pills. It’s me who doesn’t deserve such a dutiful wife." He smiled as he brought his face close to hers.
"Fufufu~~ husband’s pretty good with words today, huh?" Feiyan snuggled into Qingyi’s arms, her full, red lips curving subtly.
It wasn’t long before the sect’s flying ship set sail.
The two of them stood by a window, watching the sect drift away as they disappeared among the soft, white clouds.
"Husband... do you promise you’ll try not to take too many risks during the competition?" She asked, her voice low and slightly shaky.
"I... I’ll try, I promise." He said, looking away slightly.
"You’re a terrible liar..."
Qingyi couldn’t help but smile bitterly.
In a way, he really was a terrible liar.
They just enjoyed each other’s warmth as the journey went on.
That part of the ship was crowded with core disciples and, every now and then, they received one envious glance or another, but they simply ignored it.
"Junior Brother Qingyi, are you excited for the Scarlet Dragon Competition?" Juechen’s voice echoed.
Waving gently to Feiyan, he sat down on the other side.
"A little," Qingyi replied. "Senior Brother Juechen has already taken part, right?"

"Yes, I took part three years ago. It was a hell of a year, we had a lot of talent from all the sects. Luckily, I went with the elder from the war hall, so I didn’t have so many problems." Juechen laughed.
As the sect leader’s cultivation realm was too high to enter the Scarlet Dragon Secret Realm, it was only natural that his disciple would be forced to go with someone else if he wanted to take part.
Unlike other types of competitions between sects, the scarlet dragon competition was much more closed.
Generally, only two disciples and elders from each sect took part each year, with the choice being completely random.
This year, it would be the turn of elder Qingxue and the sect’s internal affairs elder, which forced the silver-haired beauty to start her search for direct disciples.
For the rest of the trip, they talked about various topics, mainly focusing on the competition, how it worked and what Qingyi needed to know in order to gain as much as possible.
The handsome young man couldn’t deny that the help Juechen had given her had been very welcome, greatly broadening her view of the competition.
After another seven days of travel, they finally arrived at their destination.
With only ten thousand inhabitants, the Scarlet Dragon City was relatively small by the standards of the Blue Moon Continent, but even so, no one dared to look down on it.
That city was in the center of the continent’s outer region, one of the areas with the highest density of Qi and one of the few places where even beasts of the Burning Blood Realm roamed freely.
The city was protected by five Burning Blood Realm experts who guarded the Scarlet Dragon Secret Realm, with even the weakest inhabitants being in the foundation realm.
The Ascending Dragon Sect’s ship quickly caught the attention of the locals as it docked alongside two other flying ships in the city’s central courtyard.
One of them carried the symbol of the Burning Heart Sect while the other, the symbol of the Serene Cloud Sect.
"I wish you good luck, Junior Brother Qingyi." Juechen smiled, slapping him on the shoulder as he left.
"We’re there, wake up." Qingyi shook Feiyan, who was sleeping peacefully in his embrace.
"Uhn... already?" With a sleepy grunt, she got up and, together with the rest of the sect’s entourage, went outside.
Qingyi’s eyes swept the crowd watching them, soon focusing on two men approaching on the horizon.
The first was a bald man, his body sunburnt and covered in scars.
He was the leader of the Burning Heart Sect.
The other, a man with long black hair and beard, neatly combed and elegantly tied.
This was the leader of the Serene Cloud Sect and the father of the arrogant young master whom Qingyi had almost killed during the tempest secret realm on the Heavenly Thunder Kingdom.
Jinhai took the lead of the ascending dragon sect’s entourage, his robes swaying in the wind as he smiled at the other two sect leaders.
He opened his mouth to greet them, but before he could even speak, he was interrupted by a loud, irritating voice.
"Daddy, That’s the bastard I was talking about! he tried to murder me and stole the treasure from me!" A figure appeared next to the leader of the Serene Cloud Sect.
That was young master Shen, his mouth still missing a few teeth and his face still bearing subtle marks from Qingyi’s fists.

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - Your disciple is a liar!
paragraphs: The central square of the city of the scarlet dragon was filled with silence.
No one dared to make a single sound, only the faint whistling of the wind in the ears of everyone there could be heard.
Young Master Shen was shaking with anger as he pointed in Qingyi’s direction.
The leader of the Serene Cloud Sect focused his gaze on the handsome young man, unable to contain his powerful aura from the peak of the Burning Blood Realm that was involuntarily leaking out.
So that was the brat who dared to attempt the life of his beloved son?
"Jinhai... I hope you have a good explanation for that." He took a step forward, his eyes bloodshot and the noble features of his middle-aged face hardening like ice.
Jinhai turned his face, staring at Qingyi, whose expression remained serene and calm despite the glint of murderous intent inside his beautiful black eyes.
"You’ve been to the Heavenly Thunder Realm, right?" Jinhai asked.
He already knew the answer to that question, but he wanted confirmation from Qingyi himself.
"Husband..." Feiyan called out anxiously, her long, delicate fingers entwining with Qingyi’s and clenching nervously.
"Don’t worry," he whispered, returning the tanned beauty’s squeeze.
Raising his head, Qingyi replied: "Yes, sect leader, I’ve been to the Heavenly Thunder Realm and fought against Young Master Shen in the Tempest Secret Realm."
Those words sent shock through the crowd, dozens of hushed whispers ringing out among the people watching them.
"But-" Qingyi opened his mouth, but before he could even complete his sentence, Young Master Shen’s voice interrupted him.

"I told you, he’s the one who tried to murder me, I demand justice!" The arrogant young man shouted, clutching his father’s robes while his eyes fixed on the sword that hung from Qingyi’s waist. "That’s the artifact he stole from me!"
"You’re right my son," The leader of the Serene Cloud Sect closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, they were filled with murderous intent.
"Such an act deserves punishment!" He growled, his saber sliding out of its sheath and launching a single slash of wind Qi towards Qingyi.
The handsome young man raised his heaven-defying thunder sword and pushed Feiyan away.
Jinhai wasn’t moving and it looked like he would have to fend for himself.
That attack obviously carried only a fraction of the Serene Cloud sect leader’s power, but it was still a powerful blow.
A loud bang echoed through the square, followed by a powerful shockwave.
The heaven-defying thunder sword flickered softly and Qingyi gritted his teeth, carefully controlling his Qi to prevent it from showing beyond the peak of the golden core realm.
He was forced to take two steps back, his arms trembling as smoke left the sword in his hands.
His lightning sword Qi spread across the silver-purple blade, making the air around him boil.
At that moment, the pitying looks in his direction turned to absolute shock.

That young man from the Golden Core realm had just fended off a blow from an expert at the peak of the Burning Blood realm and one of the most powerful cultivators in the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent?
Even a hundredth of the power of the leader of the Serene Cloud Sect should be enough to crush Qingyi like an insect! How could that be possible?
When they saw that Jinhai wasn’t moving, they all believed it was the end of Qingyi.
But now they realized the truth, Jinhai hadn’t moved because he didn’t think it was necessary!
"Sect leader," Qingyi turned towards Jinhai, ignoring the shocked looks. "May I explain myself?"
Deaths between sect disciples were common.
Disputes over resources, duels for honor, all of this occurred regularly and even though there were technically laws between the sects prohibiting murder, these rarely had any real effect.
But there was an exception to that. Rich and powerful people killed in unofficial confrontations.
Naturally, Qingyi trying to kill the son of the leader of one of the three great sects was seen as an extremely serious matter.
"Go ahead," Jinhai replied, turning to the leader of the Serene Cloud Sect.
"Shen Lianhe, allow my disciple to defend himself before passing judgment. I will ignore this initial disrespect, but if it is repeated..."
Jinhai’s voice changed, losing its dignity and being dominated by a powerful, furious aura.
The faint, enormous image of a golden dragon appeared on his back, pulsating with ancient power.
Lianhe took a step back, breaking out in a cold sweat.
Turning his face, he observed the leader of the Burning Heart Sect, who had exactly the same look as him.
Although they both had the same cultivation as Jinhai, his lineage was simply too powerful for them to confront.
"Very well," Lianhe controlled the tremor in his voice, turning to Qingyi. "Go ahead, boy," he said, holding his son by the shoulder.

"Thank you for your understanding, Senior. I did indeed fight your son, but it was in self-defense, so much so that, as you can see, I used my fists instead of my sword to immobilize him." Qingyi spoke, unable to hide the mockery in his last words as he looked at Young Master Shen’s scarred face.
"Lies! He attacked me, tried to murder me and steal what was rightfully mine!" Young Master Shen roared, clutching his father’s robes.
"Daddy, I demand his life! Please, my Dao heart will never be the same if I don’t wash away this shame!"
"Ah..." Lianhe sighed heavily, his aura exploding from his body in full power, colliding with Jinhai’s.
"You’ll have to compensate me, either with blood or with the boy’s sword. My son has an interest in this item and I believe it is suitable as an apology." Lianhe spoke.
He was inferior to Jinhai, but he couldn’t let his face be thrown into the mud like that.
He had to protect the honor of his sect and his son.
"My disciple has already said it was self-defense, and I believe him. Back off, I’d rather not stain this sacred place with blood," Jinhai replied firmly.
"Your disciple is a liar!" Lianhe retorted furiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 163 - scarlet secret realm 01
paragraphs: Twelve people stood in front of the statue of a dragon whose scales were scarlet red.
One of them was the powerful figure of Qing Shuyin next to the curvaceous silhouette of his daughter, Qing Ruyan.
Next to them were another elder and disciple of the Serene Cloud Sect, along with the two elders and then disciples of the Burning Heart Sect.
Qingyi and Qingxue were on the left of the group, next to the elder Chen Wutian and the direct disciple Feng Zhenhai from the Ascending Dragon Sect.
In total, there were six disciples from the peak of the Golden Core realm and six elders from the peak of the Iron Body realm.
That was a power big enough to take down a medium-sized sect, but it seemed small compared to the figures surrounding them.
"You look beautiful today, elder Qingxue," Wutian smiled at the silver-haired beauty, but she didn’t even turn towards him, her eyes focused straight ahead, cold and serene.
The old man could only focus on the statue in front of him as well, gritting his teeth.
Qingyi obviously realized this, his fists clenched tightly, but soon relaxed.
That damned old man was obviously begging for death, but Qingyi couldn’t go around killing everyone for a simple compliment.
As long as the old man didn’t cross the line, he wouldn’t either.
Hiding the anger in his heart, he turned to the figure of the leader of the scarlet dragon elders.
"Greetings, young disciples and respectable elders," he spoke, imbuing his voice with Qi and causing it to spread throughout Scarlet Dragon City.
His speech was short, brief words of encouragement followed by a few instructions.
With a big smile on his lips, he snapped his fingers.
The next moment, the statue moved, seized by an intense Qi as its huge head lowered and its mouth opened, revealing a blood-red portal.
Shuyin was the first to step forward, Ruyan following soon after.
Only when their bodies disappeared into the portal did the others follow.
"Let’s go," Qingxue spoke as she took a light, elegant step forward, her hand resting on the hilt of her swords.
The moment they passed through the portal, they felt the air around them change.
Qingxue’s long, silky silver hair fluttered as she was hit by a strong, humid breeze.
She took a step back, her head hitting Qingyi’s broad chest and making her shiver and blush softly.
"That’s a hell of a view, hahaha," one of the elders of the Burning Heart Sect, a burly and honest man, smiled as he looked at the horizon.
They were at the top of a rock formation, high above the clouds.
A waterfall fell above them, descending into a green abyss.
No one there could deny that it was a beautiful sight, their eyes lost in the great forests that stretched to the horizon of clouds made golden by the setting sun.
"We have to run," Qingyi said, activating his draconic vision.
"Uh? What do you mean? Junior Brother Qingyi-" Ruxue stopped her own words, her eyes twitching.
Just ahead of the sun, she saw a small dot rapidly approaching.
This small dot soon turned into dozens and then hundreds.
They were flying beasts.
The sheer number didn’t frighten any of the elders, but the moment they felt the cultivations of those creatures, they couldn’t help but feel their hearts sink.
Each of those beasts was at the Iron Body realm, with their leader, an eagle with a wingspan of more than twenty meters, only a single step away from the Burning Blood realm.
"Run!" One word and all those proud elders abandoned their dignity.
Chen Wutian was the first to run, activating his movement technique at maximum speed as he passed under the waterfall.
"There’s a door over there!" He said, without even realizing that Qingxue and even Qingyi had already passed him.
The silver-haired beauty passed through the door, waiting for everyone to enter. The last to arrive were Chen Wutian and his disciple.
The old man was forced to grab Zhenhai by the collar of his shirt and throw him towards the living room.
Zhenhai couldn’t hide a startled cry as he was thrown, but that cry was soon replaced by a bright look as he realized where he was going.
That route... would Elder Qingxue catch him?
He closed his eyes, hoping to reach the elder’s soft, snowy peaks, but unfortunately for him, Qingyi stepped aside at the last moment.
What Zhenhai hit was a masculine chest, broad and firm.
With Qingyi contracting every one of his muscles, the sensation Zhenhai experienced was not unlike hitting a concrete wall.
"Is everything all right, young master Zhenhai?" Qingyi flashed a broad smile.
Honestly, as well as defending his wife’s dignity, he had also saved Zhenhai’s life.
He was pretty sure that idiot would be cut into a thousand pieces if he came into contact with Qingxue.
"Y-yes," Zhenhai stood up hastily, unable to hold back a silent curse.
"Close the door, quick!" Chen Wutian roared as he passed through the steel door.
Shuyin acted quickly, his powerful muscles almost jumping out of his shirt as he closed the door with a bang.
At that moment, they finally had time to look around.
They were in an armory of sorts, surrounded by shelves full of ancient weapons and armor.
Qingxue picked up a sword curiously, but to her surprise, the blade fell apart in her fingers.
Everything there seemed to have been consumed by time.
"You’ve got good eyesight, kid, and fast feet, hahaha!" Shuyin finally relaxed, not feeling the creatures outside anymore.
They seemed to have given up following them as soon as the door closed.
"The marriage proposal with my daughter still stands," he smiled, slapping Qingyi hard on the shoulder.
"Dad!" Ruyan called out, blushing deeply.
Qingyi was about to reply when he felt his master’s piercing gaze on his back.
’Is that woman jealous?’ he thought, unable to stop himself from smiling softly at the possibility.
After a moment’s thought, he just ignored the other men’s envious glances.
This was no time for jokes, they had to continue with the secret realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - scarlet secret realm 02
paragraphs: "This place looks like some kind of fortress..."
Elder Wutian commented as they left the armory, soon finding themselves surrounded by stone walls in a corridor that seemed to have no end.
"And a dangerous one." The other elder of the Serene Cloud Sect placed his hand on the wall, sending out a small pulse of IQ.
His eyes suddenly widened and he hastily withdrew his hand.
"What is it? Did you feel something?" Shuyin asked.
That elder was the only formations expert in the place. Naturally, seeing him so disturbed made everyone’s heart flutter.
"Yes." The elder nodded and took a single step backwards, grabbing his disciple’s shoulders.

"We were quite lucky, this is the place where the scarlet dragon’s inheritance is, but the whole place is full of powerful formations. I don’t know if they’re dangerous or not, I need to study a bit more."
"Hm..." Shuyin scratched his chin, his mind lost in thought before speaking.
"I know it’s normal for us to split up, but I think it would be better if we stayed together to avoid-"
Before he had even finished his sentence, the elders of the Burning Heart Sect had already turned their backs and disappeared over the horizon.
"Ah... Stubborn idiots." Wutian shook his head, turning towards Qingxue.
"Elder Qingxue, I believe we should listen to Shuyin and..." Only then did Wutian notice the silver-haired beauty’s back moving away.
Qingyi thought that Shuyin was right and that they should stick together, but if his master wanted to split up, what could he do?
He exchanged a brief glance with Ruyan, admiring her beautiful blushing face before also turning to follow his master.
He would very much like to have a chance to be alone with her and win her for himself, but that could be left for later.
"Master seems in a hurry, is something troubling you?" Qingyi smiled as they walked away. "I can help the master relax if you want."
No longer sensing anyone’s presence, he wrapped his right arm around her waist, his hand going up to her breasts and squeezing until he heard a sweet, embarrassed moan.
"Nghnn~~ shameless disciple..." Qingxue shuddered in Qingyi’s arms.
She tried to resist and push him away, but in the end, she just lowered her blushing face in defeat.
"When you’re ready to advance to the Burning Blood Realm, you’ll understand. I need that bloodline."
She gasped softly and, gathering her strength, finally managed to escape from her disciple’s arms.
"If I don’t get that bloodline, it could take me decades or even centuries to make a breakthrough, and I don’t have that much time."
Qingxue’s voice regained some of its original coldness, a subtle glint of anger appearing on her face.
She took a quick step forward, leaving a confused Qingyi behind.
He was naturally well aware of the requirements for a breakthrough to the Burning Blood Realm.

In order to have a high chance of success, in addition to an extremely powerful cultivation room and a breakthrough pill, some kind of blood essence from a beast of the Burning Blood Realm or at least whose origin was related to a beast of the Burning Blood Realm or higher was also required.
Cultivators who had a lineage like Jinhai usually didn’t need these things, just their own lineage was enough.

But since Qingxue didn’t have a bloodline, she depended on either finding a beast of that level and being able to extract the blood essence from it, or getting the blood essence directly from an unawakened bloodline.
Both were extremely difficult to obtain and the opportunities to have them came along only once every few tens or hundreds of centuries.
That wasn’t something that worried Qingyi too much. With the system’s store, he wouldn’t have any difficulty with those things.
’But... why is she in such a hurry for it?’ A doubt arose in Qingyi’s mind, that doubt lasting until he finally remembered his first meeting with Feiyan.
Qingxue was a cultivator from the Xu family, one of the most powerful swordsman families on the continent and whose leader was only one step away from the Burning Blood realm.
She had come to the sect fleeing a forced marriage and as far as Qingyi knew, she had not yet officially cut ties with her family.
Even if the patriarch of the Xu family reached the Burning Blood Realm before her, he simply wouldn’t be able to do anything against her, not as long as Jinhai lived.
’Unless what she’s worried about is her fiancé’s family.’ Qingyi thought.
But who in the entire outer region of the Blue Moon Continent would be able to defy the Ascending Dragon Sect and force one of its strongest elders into a marriage?
"Master, the person your father wanted to force you to marry, is it someone from the Nine Peaks Basin?"
Qingxue suddenly stopped, her whole body shuddering as she clenched her fists. "That’s my problem," she said before resuming walking.
"No." Qingyi embraced her from behind, his hands roaming her sensual curves as he pulled her against him.
"You’re my woman, that’s my problem too. It won’t be long until I reach the basin of the nine peaks, and when I do, I promise you, that son of a bitch will be the first one I kill."
Those words sent a shiver down Qingxue’s spine, her already flushed face becoming even more fiery as her heart pounded.
Her rosy lips parted, but she didn’t have time to say anything.
A loud explosion echoed, followed by powerful Qi spreading throughout the fortress.
"That’s coming from the front," Qingyi stepped back, grabbing his sword.
"The inheritance!" Qingxue shouted as she started running down the corridors, her body gripped by an intense gale as she activated her movement technique.
Qingyi followed close behind, activating his lightning steps.
They followed the trail of Qi, soon arriving at a large steel door.
Qingxue drew her double swords, her wind and sword Qi glowing around the blades as she cut the door in half, entering a large hall.
"You bastard!" a hate-filled roar echoed as one of the elders of the Burning Heart Sect advanced towards a colossal figure in front of him.
It was a dragon, identical to the statue they had entered to get to the secret realm.
Its scales glowed a blood red as its serpentine body, over fifty meters long, intertwined with the pillars that held the hall up.
There were already three bodies under the floor, all from the Burning Heart Sect.

Elder Wutian commented as they left the armory, soon finding themselves surrounded by stone walls in a corridor that seemed to have no end.

Stubborn idiots." Wutian shook his head, turning towards Qingxue.

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - scarlet secret realm 03
paragraphs: "Shit!" The elder of the Burning Heart Sect realized his mistake as his flaming fist struck the beast’s head.
A loud explosion echoed and the beast’s head was thrown backwards as flames engulfed a large part of its body.
In the next moment, the pillars cracked under the weight of the beast, collapsing the ceiling to the ground.
The elder of the Burning Heart Sect turned around, his desperate eyes meeting Qingyi’s as tons of rocks fell above him.
Even if he was an expert at the peak of the Iron Body Realm, it was still difficult to survive.
"Back off!" Qingxue grabbed Qingyi’s arms and they headed back down the corridor, a cloud of dust rising as the rocks fell with a deafening crash.
Qingyi raised his arms, protecting his face from the shockwave.
When the dust settled, it revealed the subtle moonlight bathing the pile of rubble.
"Elder Qingxue!" A powerful voice echoed from behind him.
It was Shuyin, with Ruyan and the other two elders and their disciples close behind.
"What the hell happened?" he asked.
"The elders of the Burning Heart Sect found the guardian of the Scarlet Dragon Inheritance," she replied coldly, biting her rosy lips as she took a step towards the now collapsed hall.
She raised her eyes, staring at the moon that rose majestically in the sky, the pale skin of her cleavage glistening in the silver light.
Shuyin naturally didn’t take long to understand what had happened, gritting his teeth.
"Where’s the guardian? Is he dead?" Shuyin asked, but his answer soon came.
The ground beneath their feet shook, first slightly and subtly, almost imperceptibly.
But suddenly, they were thrown upwards with a crash as a serpentine, wound-covered body burst through the stones, a thunderous roar escaping as the dragon opened its mouth.
Qingyi drew his heaven-defying thunder sword, slicing through the sea of stones thrown up by the dragon.
Not even a single piece of stone passed through his blade and hit his immaculate white robes.

"Elder Qingxue and elder Wutian, let’s fight together! That body must have enough blood essence for the four of us to advance to the Burning Blood Realm!" Shuyin shouted, unable to hide the greed in his gaze.
Qingxue only nodded silently, her eyes carrying a deadly glint as her two swords danced around her body.
Qingyi stepped forward, thinking about taking part.
His power was probably superior to all those elders and certainly enough for battle, but in the end, he preferred not to take part.
In the eyes of everyone there, he was just a cultivator of the Golden Core realm. He would only fight if necessary to protect his master.
"Looks like we won’t be getting any gains, Junior Brother Qingyi," Ruyan approached, a bitter smile taking over her face.
Usually, they would appear far from the inheritance site and would need to make a journey of days or even weeks, where they would find artifacts and cultivation materials of incomparable value.
Unfortunately, they appeared too close and the elders would probably be the only ones to make any gains there.
"Yes," Qingyi returned Ruyan’s smile, just watching the battle, the powerful auras of the peak of the Iron Body realm colliding with the dragon.
"Elder Qingxue, I’ll hold him back, pierce this bastard’s heart!" Shuyin spoke, a streak of blood running down his face as he grabbed the dragon’s jaw, forcing it shut.
The other two elders grabbed the dragon’s tail, roaring as they struggled to hold it.
"Right." Qingxue stopped her steps, aligning her two swords before advancing, a powerful wind Qi forming a whirlpool around the blades.
The dragon could do nothing but let a heartbreaking cry escape its lips as a hole appeared in its chest.
Its huge body struggled desperately before finally losing its strength, one last gasp escaping from between its sharp teeth before the life drained from its eyes.

"Ah... we’re lucky the cave-in hurt him, we wouldn’t have survived if he’d been at full strength." Wutian approached, a big smile taking over his face as he felt a reddish Qi spread through the dragon’s body.
This was a clear sign that they had succeeded, that the millennia-long struggle to obtain the scarlet dragon’s inheritance would finally come to an end.

Even though none of them was a blood cultivator, the bloodline that this inheritance carried and the very blood essence of the dragon that protected the bloodline was more than enough to guarantee everyone’s advancement.
Unfortunately, Wutian’s smile didn’t last long, a strong touch squeezing his shoulder.
"Uh? Elder Shuyin? Something wrong-" Wutian’s words were interrupted, his eyes wide as he realized something.
He could see his own decapitated body.
"Today is a great day for the Serene Cloud Sect. With four other cultivators from the Burning Blood Realm, we will surely be supreme!" Shuyin smiled cruelly as he turned towards the dead dragon.
The red Qi had gathered into a small crimson orb that now floated subtly in the air.
Qingxue acted the moment after the betrayal, but it was too late.
The other elder appeared behind her, his palm falling on her delicate back and sending her to the ground.
In the next moment, he sent two more attacks towards Qingyi and Zhenhai, whose bodies were thrown against the stone wall, their figures disappearing in an explosion of dust.
"How dare you betray us!" Qingxue fell to her knees, coughing up a large gulp of blood.
She had suffered catastrophic internal damage and could barely maintain consciousness.

"Nothing personal, Elder Qingxue, it’s just that the Ascending Dragon Sect has reigned supreme for too long. It’s time for a new ruler to emerge." The elder approached Qingxue, preparing to finish his service.
But he stopped at the last moment.
A shiver ran down his spine, a murderous intent so powerful it was almost palpable falling over him.
Turning around, he saw a pair of purple eyes shining through the dust, staring at him as if they could see his very soul.
It was not unlike looking into the eyes of death itself.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - Xue Ruyan
paragraphs: "I didn’t want to kill anyone, not today." A cold, spiteful voice echoed, "but..."
The elder of the Serene Cloud sect took a step back, trying to retreat towards Shuyin.
But it was already too late.
"You’ve really soured my mood." Qingyi’s voice rang out, his body turning into a blur and cutting the distance between them in the blink of an eye.
His Qi changed immediately, from the peak of the golden core realm to the iron body realm, falling on the elder and forcing him to stop.
Qingyi didn’t even draw his sword. He raised his hands and grabbed the elder’s jaw firmly.
"What did you-" The elder’s eyes widened in terror, but Qingyi ignored his reaction, strengthening his grip until he felt the bones crack between his fingers.
The elder didn’t even have time to scream.
His jaw was crushed in Qingyi’s hands, his teeth and bones tearing skin and flesh as they were shredded.
Qingyi didn’t even use Qi. Only the sheer physical strength he received from advancing to the Iron Body realm was enough.
The old man fell to his knees.
His eyes watered as horrible, pain-filled grunts escaped from what was left of the bloody mess that was his face.
"Master, NO!" The elder’s disciple roared, his eyes filled with hatred as he drew his sword and advanced towards Qingyi.
"If you want to die with that damned old man so badly." Qingyi took a single step to the side before swinging the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword.
His lightning sword qi formed a thunderous ethereal blade that aligned perfectly with both their necks.
In a single second, they were both dead.
Qingyi didn’t bother paying attention to the bodies, focusing instead on his master, whose consciousness was already fading.
He rushed over to her, putting a pill in his mouth and kissing her, forcing her to swallow.
’Ruxue,’ he called in his mind. ’Your current power is close to the Iron Body realm, right? How far can I get away from you without affecting our connection?’
"Hmm... about four or five kilometers," the spiritual beauty replied.
’"Good, protect Qingxue. I have to deal with some filthy trash. ’ Qingyi stood up, grabbing the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword and placing it next to his master’s body.
His beautiful black eyes rose, filled with the deep, bright purple of his draconic eyes as he watched Qing Shuyin.
The great elder shuddered, taking a step back and gritting his teeth.
His eyes glowed with hatred as he held the red orb tightly in his hands.
"Damned brat, do you think that just because you hid your cultivation and succeeded in ambushing that weakling you can deal with me?" Shuyin roared, but Qingyi completely ignored him.
His sight was focused on Ruyan, who was hiding behind her father.
Strangely, she wasn’t watching him with fear or anger.
On the contrary, there was only a deep curiosity on her face.
"Would you forgive me if I killed your father?" Qingyi asked.
To his surprise, the moment he spoke those words, a big smile came over Ruyan’s face.
That was... strange. Why was she reacting like that?
A million questions arose in Qingyi’s mind, but his attention was soon taken by the golden aura that spread through Shuyin’s body.
"You dare ignore me and still ask my daughter such a question?" Shuyin roared, his voice filled with murderous intent.
He stepped forward, ready to attack, but stopped at the last moment.
An intense pain pierced his back and burst through his chest.
He looked down as he vomited blood.
Sticking out of his chest and holding his still-beating heart was a small, delicate hand, one he knew very well.
Another hand grabbed his right hand, taking the red orb from it.
"Ruyan... Why?" he asked, his eyes filling with tears as his body lost strength.
The beauty paid no attention to those words.
The smile on her face grew even wider as she squeezed Shuyin’s heart, crushing it in an explosion of blood.
"You..." Qingyi called out, unable not to feel a little anxious. "Who the hell are you?"
"Ah..." The beauty exhaled heavily before turning her face towards Qingyi.

"You know... ever since we first met, I saw that there was something different about you." She replied, her voice no longer the same as Ruyan’s, no longer dignified and serene, taking on a high-pitched, playful and strangely adorable tone.
"Now I see that you’re much more than I thought." The moment her voice dropped, the world around her seemed to change.
Her long black hair came untied, falling in cascades over her shoulders, a fringe covering her forehead and a pair of black horns rising from her head.
Her wide blue dress changed shape, taking on a black hue and clinging to her voluptuous chest and delicate waist.
The scaly fabric covered in blood-red details ran down between the deep valley of her plump, perfectly round buttocks, perfectly demarcating their full curve.
Her skin, once clear and rosy, turned a deep pale white, not inferior to Ruxue’s skin.
Only her beautiful face, adorned with blood-red lips and eyes, retained slightly flushed cheeks.
She was, without a doubt, even more beautiful than the Ruyan that Qingyi knew.
No, Ruyan was barely a match for the woman in front of Qingyi.
’System, shouldn’t draconic eyes be able to see through any illusion?’
[Yes, but that’s not an illusion, it’s a shapeshifting technique]
The system’s response sent a shiver down Qingyi’s spine as he looked at the woman’s status.
[Name: Xue Ruyan
Age: 29
Corruption: 0/100
Chastity: Intact
Lust: 3%
Talent: Genius
Reward: Incalculable
Cultivation: ninth stage of the crystalline core realm (suppressed to the peak of the iron body realm)
Spiritual roots: Low-level blood spiritual root
Bloodline: None
Constitution: None
Traits: Faithful, naughty crazy bitch, masochist, master of hemomancy, hundredth child of the leader of the demonic cult, half-demon]
Seeing her traits, Qingyi froze.
"Uh? Aren’t you going to say anything? Too stunned by my beauty? Fufufu~~" Ruyan leaned forward, a teasing, sweet laugh escaping her plump red lips.
"Maybe I can give you a hand." She raised a single finger, pointing it towards the fallen Qingxue.
In the next moment, blood was sucked from the bodies on the ground, leaving them completely dry and forming a spear of blood in front of her fingers.
Without hesitation, she threw it towards the silver-haired beauty.
At that very moment, Qingyi moved.
His body turned into a blur as he appeared in front of the blade and activated the scales of the black dragon, grabbing it with his bare hands.
"You know," Qingyi squeezed hard, the spear shattering into scarlet fragments.
"I only planned to fuck you and make you my new wife. Those plans haven’t changed. But if you dare to do this again..."
Qingyi activated the lightning steps.
A shockwave spread from where he left as he closed the gap between him and Ruyan in a split second.
"I promise you’ll get hurt."

"What’s up, husband? Want to have a little fun?" Ruyan asked as her back sank into the soft couch.

"But not now, we have important things to talk about."

"I plan to cross over to the Nine Peaks Basin soon, as soon as my master reaches the Burning Blood Realm. What do I need to worry about?"
"Hmm... I have no idea!" Ruyan replied after a moment’s thought, drawing a weary sigh from Qingyi.
"We have our own flying ships that make this journey, so I’ve never been near the mountain ranges. All I know is their horrible mortality."
Qingyi scratched his chin.
A flying ship... That would be a good idea.
But he doubted very much that going on the demon cult’s ship would be smart.
If he could get the sect’s, on the other hand, it would be perfect.
The crossing could take months and they would have to fight crystalline core realm beasts, perhaps hundreds or thousands of them.
That wasn’t a fight he wanted to buy.
Qingyi’s thoughts were interrupted by the sound of a door opening.
Raising his vision, he saw two beautiful, voluptuous figures approaching.
It was Qingxue and Feiyan.
During the trip, Qingyi had "helped" the two become much closer, to a level where they could even be considered friends.
The two looked at Ruyan with shock, especially when they noticed the pair of horns on the demon beauty’s head.
"Qingyi... who’s that woman?" Feiyan asked.
"Oh... don’t you remember me anymore, little sister Feiyan? Even after we spent so long talking about so many things." A betrayed expression appeared on Ruyan’s face.
Feiyan froze for a few moments, her shock turning to disbelief. "R-ruyan?"
"Who else would it be? Hehehe!" Ruyan jumped up from the couch, hugging Feiyan, their huge breasts squeezing against each other.
Qingxue watched the two with a doubtful expression.
Was that Ruyan? The same Ruyan she knew? How could that be possible?
Spreading her senses, she tried to feel Ruyan’s cultivation, but couldn’t sense anything.
It was as if Ruyan didn’t even exist.
"Qingyi," Qingxue called out, her voice cold and serene. "Can you explain what’s going on here? Is this woman a demon cultivator?"
"Well..." Qingyi scratched the back of his neck.
It took long minutes of explaining everything before the girls finally understood what was going on.
Feiyan didn’t care much about Ruyan being the daughter of the demon cult leader.
She barely knew anything about the cult and was honestly just happy that her friend was okay.
Qingxue had a little more trouble accepting it, but in the end, she just stood up and turned away.
"I’ll go into seclusion to prepare for my breakthrough." Qingxue spoke, thinking for a brief moment before continuing. "The sect leader wants to see you, go and meet him as soon as possible."
"Right," Qingyi nodded, approaching Qingxue and kissing her lightly. "Good luck, master."
Qingxue blushed deeply before walking away, leaving only Qingyi, Feiyan and Ruyan in the large, luxurious living room.
The handsome young man was excited to have fun with the two of them, but in the end, he preferred to go and see the sect leader first.
Before leaving, Qingyi turned to Ruyan. "There was an attack in the north of the kingdom a few months ago, they were planning to summon a real demon. Do you know anything about that attack?"
"No," Ruyan shook her head.
"There are many families and clans within the demon cult, none of them are exactly friends and have their own private affairs, it must have been one of them."
"I see..." Qingyi reflected for a brief moment.
It was good to know that Ruyan hadn’t taken part in such a horrendous act.
Placing a kiss on each of the voluptuous beauties’ lips, Qingyi left, leaving them alone.
The sect leader’s palace was obviously in chaos as they searched for the source of that powerful aura.
That aura had covered not only the sect, but the entire golden clouds city, a huge dragon’s head being visible for a brief moment before disappearing.
Fortunately, almost everyone who saw it were low-level cultivators and lost consciousness immediately, unable to pinpoint exactly where the black dragon’s head was.
Qingyi walked past the many guards protecting the palace and into the great central hall.
The sect leader was not on his throne.
"Here." A dignified, aged voice called out to Qingyi.
Following this voice, Qingyi entered a room where Jinhai was sitting at a table, an old book and a bottle of liquor on it.
"Sit down," Jinhai waved his hand, smiling gently at Qingyi.
The sect leader had a tired expression on his face.
"Disciple Long Qingyi greets the sect leader," Qingyi bowed before sitting down. "What does the sect leader want from this humble disciple?"
Jinhai didn’t answer immediately, pouring himself a glass of liquor before serving Qingyi.
"Drink up, this is a bottle I’ve kept for centuries, a treasure even in the basin of the nine peaks," Jinhai said.
After Qingyi had taken the first sip, Jinhai continued: "You must already know that your master is planning to go to the Nine Peaks Basin. Are you going with her?"
"Yes, Feiyan is going with us too," Qingyi nodded.
There was no point in lying about it.
"Madame Xue won’t be happy about it."
"Well, the sect leader himself said that the older generation shouldn’t get involved in the younger generation’s love.
I believe that as an upholder of love, the sect leader won’t allow them to force us apart."
"Hahaha!" Jinhai let out an uncontrolled laugh.
"Yes." His laughter was replaced by a bitter smile. "I’ll protect your love."
Taking a sip of his liquor, Jinhai looked at the horizon.
"I’ll lend you the sect’s flying ship, it will drop you off at the Nine Peaks Basin and then return. After that, we’ll have no further connection."
"No connection? Does the sect leader really think I’ll forget your kindness?
My only desire is to accompany the master. When I reach the peak of my talent there, I’ll do my best to repay you for everything you’ve done for me."
Those words made Jinhai shudder, remembering his younger self and his master.
After a few hesitant moments, Jinhai waved his hand. "You can leave now, I’ll remember that promise."
Bowing respectfully, Qingyi left the sect leader’s palace, unable not to smile.
He could finally go to the Nine Peaks Basin and truly begin his path to immortality.

A place like this... how could it be possible?

In the end, she could only look at her husband with trembling eyes.
"Do you want to stay with your master?" Qingyi asked, sensing the pain in Feiyan.
"No," Feiyan shook her head.
"I want to be with the husband.
I just wanted the master not to be heartbroken."
"A woman of her level won’t be like that for long.
Besides, all you have to do is work hard to reach the Nascent Soul Realm and you’ll be able to cross over freely to come and visit her."
"Nascent soul realm?
Do you know how far away that is?"
About two years?" Qingyi asked, drawing a laugh from Feiyan.
Going from the Golden Core Realm to the Nascent Soul Realm in just two years was something that not even the most talented geniuses in the Nine Peaks Basin were capable of doing.
But looking at her husband and remembering all his achievements, she simply couldn’t doubt him.
"Hm... where are the girls from the temple?
I went to visit them while the husband was cultivating and the temple was empty."
Speaking of them." Qingyi smiled softly before grabbing Feiyan’s hands and the heaven-defying thunder sword.
He closed his eyes and the space around him distorted.
When he opened them again, they were in Ruxue’s world of the mind.
Feiyan’s eyes immediately widened as she looked around, unable to believe her own vision.
A place like this... how could it be possible?
"Sister Feiyan!"
Her question was answered by an excited call as the temple doors opened, revealing the excited priestesses.
They immediately surrounded Feiyan, peppering her with curious questions.
"This is Ruxue’s world of the mind." Qingyi explained.
"The density of pure Qi here isn’t very high, at least not compared to the density of lightning Qi, but it’s still a good place to cultivate."
"I see...
Does husband want me to stay here with the priestesses?" Feiyan asked, understanding Qingyi’s thoughts.
"Yes," he nodded.
"Master is due to complete her advance at any moment and when she does, we’ll go immediately to the Nine Peaks Basin.
Qingxue can defend herself, but I’m still not sure I’ll be able to keep you safe."
Feiyan hesitated for a moment, but in the end just nodded.
The company of the priestesses wasn’t bad and she had to admit that she was still weak.
She didn’t want to delay her husband because of that.
"Perfect!" Qingyi laughed.
His plan had been to leave immediately after Feiyan accepted everything, but surrounded by a sea of huge, soft boobs and panting breaths, he couldn’t do much but give himself completely to the girls.
When he had finished with them, he found himself lying on the large bed in the main room of the temple palace.

His chest was wrapped in the soft, warm and heavy embrace of Ruxue and Elize’s massive breasts, while Yunfei and Yueli’s tits were squeezing around his cock, working with Feiyan’s mouth to suck every last drop of his seed.
As difficult as pleasuring so many women at the same time was freeing himself from their embrace.
His body was covered in lipstick marks and sharp nail scratches that ran down his back, thighs, chest and abdomen.
"I’ll prepare the dragon meat for lunch tomorrow.
Husband’s going to eat with us, right?" Elize asked, hugging Qingyi one last time, her exaggerated, sensual curves quivering under his touch.
"Yes, ask Ruxue to let me know." Qingyi nodded before leaving.
Back in the real world, his senses immediately focused on a powerful aura from the Burning Blood Realm.
It seemed that his master had succeeded in making her breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - breakthrough (02)
paragraphs: Qingxue left her cultivation cave, her beautiful, serene blue eyes closing instinctively in the intense daylight.
"Congratulations on your breakthrough, Master!" Qingyi appeared in front of Qingxue, admiring her beauty for a brief moment before taking her in his arms.
His right hand rested on her slender waist while his left went up to her long silver hair.
"Did you miss your disciple?" he asked.
Qingxue’s beautiful face blushed intensely, her usual coolness melting into Qingyi’s tight embrace.
Her mind ran through many possible answers, but in the end, she could only swallow her pride and raise her vision, her eyes meeting his.
"Yes, I missed you and... thank you for everything, husband..."
"Good," Qingyi smiled. "I missed you too." He slapped her ass, gripping the voluptuous flesh tightly.
"What do you say we do one last master and disciple practice before we leave for the Nine Peaks Basin?"
"Nghnn~~" Qingxue let out a pained moan before hesitantly nodding.
She was also curious to test her new power as a Burning Blood Realm expert and was eager to see how much Qingyi had improved.
They soon found themselves in the arena of her mansion.
It was clearly insufficient to withstand the power of both of them, but it would still do.
Two sharp whistles echoed as Qingxue’s blades slid against her scabbard, both seized by a powerful wind and sword Qi as the surrounding space shook.
Unlike the Iron Body Realm, which focused entirely on strengthening the body, the Burning Blood Realm concentrated on strengthening the meridians.
As such, Qingxue’s Qi was much more powerful than before.
It was far from enough for Qingyi to feel threatened, but enough for her to be confident that she could defeat hundreds of the previous version of herself in a single move.
Qingyi drew the heaven-defying thunder sword, his body filled with a thunderous aura and the ground beneath his feet cracking with the pressure.
A cherry leaf floated through the air and the moment it hit the ground between them, they both lunged forward.
A deafening bang exploded when the two blades met.
Qingxue’s wind Qi painted the world behind her green while Qingyi’s lightning Qi ripped through the air behind her, making it boil.
After a moment of struggle, Qingxue stepped back, feeling her arms tremble.
"You’ve reached the eighth stage of the Iron Body Realm?" she asked, shocked.
"Master has good senses." Qingyi smiled as he retracted his blade.
Hearing those words, Qingxue could only shake her head.
With that breakthrough, she believed she would finally be able to surpass Qingyi, but the gap between them had only grown even wider.
She really couldn’t help but feel a little disappointed with herself.
"You’re thinking too much." Qingyi said, grabbing Qingxue’s face gently.
"Your husband still has one more gift for you." Qingyi said, opening the system store and going to the lineages and constitution category.
He had 40.000 lust points to spend, enough at least for a rare constitution and lineage for his master.
After a few moments searching, he finally found what he wanted.
[Item: Storm Phoenix bloodline.
Description: A powerful bloodline of a mythical beast whose life was long ago taken over by a coalition of experts from the ancient era.
Grade: Rare
[Item: Constitution of the Heart of the Four Winds
Description: A powerful constitution born of the four primordial winds. It used to be almost invincible even in the celestial heavens, but the ages have dissolved much of its power.
Rank: Rare
"Master, do you trust me?" Qingyi asked.
When Qingxue nodded in confirmation, he grabbed her hands, leading her into the cultivation cave and pressing his hands against her delicate back.
"Be strong, master." Qingyi spoke before purchasing the constitution and bloodline, imbuing both into Qingxue’s body.
It was a long and painful process.
The confusion on Qingxue’s face turned into painful, muffled screams.
Sweat dripped down her pale skin as every fiber of her being seemed to be ripped apart and remade.
After long hours, the pain ceased and Qingxue’s body finally fell wearily onto Qingyi’s chest.
"Ugh... what have you done to me?" Qingxue asked, panting.
She could feel the difference in her body and smell the horrible odor of a body reconstruction, but she was simply unable to understand what Qingyi had done to her and why it was so powerful.
As she stood up, her body felt much lighter, as if it were floating in the air.
Her sensitivity to Qi had increased tremendously, as had the power of the wind Qi that ran through her meridians.
Studying her Dantian, she felt a new thread of Qi in her Qi Core.
It was strangely familiar, but still distant, like something that had never existed and was there all the time at the same time.
"Is that?" Her eyes widened as she ran out of her cave.
"Wait!" Qingyi hurried after her.
Stopping in front of the courtyard of her mansion, she accessed that Qi, pushing it towards her meridians.
A powerful aura ran through her body as her appearance changed.
Her blue eyes became even deeper, shining with a light of their own while ethereal feathers subtly appeared on parts of her body.
She had never felt anything like it, but she had read countless books on the subject and had seen the sect leader himself demonstrate it to her once.
Activating her movement technique, she took a step forward.
A bang echoed as her body broke through the sound barrier and covered a distance of hundreds of meters in the blink of an eye.
"Did you like my gift for you?" Qingyi asked, observing the trembling expression on the silver-haired beauty’s face.
With tears in her eyes, she deactivated her bloodline ability and threw herself into Qingyi’s arms.
"Thank you husband... thank you for everything..." she said.
Those were tears of happiness, running down her delicate face and staining Qingyi’s clothes.
"This small place is no longer suitable for us, love." Qingyi kissed her, her plump, rosy lips untouched by the dirt of the body reconstruction.
Parting his lips from Qingxue’s, he smiled at her. "Let’s take a shower, I’m pretty sure the sect leader wants to send us away as soon as possible, hahaha."

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 177 - White Peak
paragraphs: Despite being governed by one of the nine great sects, the city of the White Peak was relatively small in the Nine Peaks basin.
With just over one million inhabitants, it was much smaller even than the capital of the Kingdom of the Golden Sun.
But its modest size didn’t mean it was weak.

Thick walls over fifty meters high protected it, covered in spiritual arrays so powerful that all the spirit crystals in the outer region of the Blue Moon Continent would barely be able to keep them active for a single moment.
Although it wasn’t coastal, the city had a large port where dozens of flying ships docked and departed every few minutes.
On the horizon, the high mountain ranges that separated the Nine Peaks basin from the rest of the continent rose majestically many tens of kilometers high.
This was the major city closest to the outer region of the continent.
Qingyi disembarked from the Ascending Dragon Sect’s flying ship, observing the world around him with interest.
The first difference he sensed was the density of Qi, dozens of times greater than even the best cultivation halls in the outer region of the Blue Moon Continent.
But that was only a fraction of the difference.
The skies seemed to be higher, and the rare flying ships were so common here that the sect’s mighty vessel was the smallest and humblest of all in the harbor.
In the streets beyond the port and the wall, cultivators from the Iron Body Realm and the Burning Blood Realm walked among mortals as if they were ordinary figures.
It was a little strange to be back at the bottom of the cultivation path food chain, but Qingyi just shook his head.
He soon felt long, delicate fingers intertwine with his own.
It was Qingxue, with her silver hair elegantly tied up and her cheeks tinged with a pale blush.
"Are you anxious?" Qingyi asked.
"A little," Qingxue nodded softly, moving even closer to him.
It had been many years since she had felt so vulnerable.
"I am too," Qingyi returned the squeeze on her hand, "but it’s necessary if we want to deal with that damned Lei family."
"I know..." Qingxue replied, her cold, serene eyes filled with determination.
Without further hesitation, they both left the port and entered the wide main street of White Peak City.

It was a truly dazzling place, with streets of pure marble and stalls where the meat of beasts from the Burning Blood Realm and even the Crystalline Core Realm was displayed as if they were ordinary animals.
Many curious eyes immediately fell on them, as if they were watching country bumpkins arriving in town.
But when they noticed Qingxue’s ethereal beauty, these gazes quickly changed to envy directed at Qingyi and desire directed at her.
The beautiful couple just ignored these reactions as they went deeper into the city.
"Get that brat!" A thunderous voice rang out, followed by the powerful Qi of the Burning Blood Realm exploding uncontrollably.
A little girl with black hair and watery eyes emerged from the crowd.
Her poor clothes were dirty and disheveled while her bare feet tapped hurriedly against the ground.
Shuddering at the shouts behind her, she kept running, deftly dodging the cultivators who filled the street.
Suddenly, a painful cry escaped her lips as her foot sank into a shard of glass, the skin tearing as she fell to the ground.
She surrendered completely to crying as she was overcome with pain.
"You little bitch!" A burly figure leapt through the sky, falling heavily next to the girl.
The lard on his belly swung wildly as his bald head glistened in the sunlight.
"I paid for you and you will serve me!" He threw a punch in her direction, even without using Qi, it was still a devastating blow for a child.
The little girl cringed with her eyes closed, waiting for an impact that never came.
When she opened them again, she saw a young man standing in front of her, holding the balled-up man’s fist.
"Who the hell are you? How dare you challenge the great Bao?" The fat man questioned, but soon realized something alarming.
No matter how hard he tried, he simply couldn’t free his hand from Qingyi’s grip.
"I don’t like playing the hero," Qingyi said, his eyes filled with murderous intent, "but I always make exceptions."
Despite his Burning Blood Realm cultivation, Bao was barely able to react when Qingyi’s fist hit his face.
Blood exploded as his nose was smashed, his teeth broken and the bones in his jaw reduced to dust in the face of Qingyi’s sheer physical strength.
Many curious looks landed on Qingyi as the powerful body fell to the ground, but he ignored them, focusing on the little girl who was already being tended to by Qingxue.
"Swallow this," Qingxue said softly, popping a healing pill into the child’s mouth before grabbing the shard of glass in her foot.
Ignoring the girl’s pained cry, she pulled hard.
"Ouch, that hurts!" The girl whimpered, her face soaked with tears as her small body arched.
"It’ll pass..." Qingxue said with a gentle smile.
In the next moment, the pain the girl had been feeling ceased, replaced by an expression of relief as the wound on her foot closed in an instant.
Unfortunately, she couldn’t enjoy the feeling for long.
As she stood up, she saw Bao’s fallen body and her whole body shuddered as she turned to Qingxue and Qingyi.
"Uncle, pretty aunt, I thank you for helping little Yao, but you need to run. He’s the brother of the leader of the Blue Crow Gang, they’ll hurt you if they find out you helped me escape from him!"
She took a shaky step towards a dark alley.
"Please follow me! I promise to pay for your help!" The little girl spoke before starting to run.
Qingyi and Qingxue only exchanged glances for a few moments before also following the girl.
The people on the street soon stopped paying attention, moving on with their lives.
The Blue Crow Gang was just a small organization whose leader was at the beginning of the Crystalline Core Realm, barely comparable to an inner disciple of one of the big sects in the region.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - Little Yao
paragraphs: Little Yao led Qingyi and Qingxue through a maze of narrow alleyways, and the world around them changed dramatically.
The tall, luxurious buildings were replaced by clumsy slums.

Where once they could see even Nascent Soul Realm cultivators, now even Foundation Realm ones were rare, with almost all of the people here being mortals who watched the couple with suspicious glances.
Yao stopped suddenly, opening a wooden door before entering and signaling for the couple to follow her.
After looking out one last time, she heaved a sigh of relief before bowing deeply.
"Little Yao asks the experts for forgiveness, but Little Yao didn’t want you to get hurt!"
She clasped her little hands together respectfully, trying unsuccessfully to put determination into her worried little face.
"There’s no need to worry, little one."
Qingyi smiled gently, placing his hand on the girl’s head and ruffling her hair.
He turned his face gently, watching Qingxue’s expression.
The silver-haired beauty looked at little Yao as if she had just found the most precious jewel in the world.
Looking at the house they were in, Qingyi couldn’t stop his heart from sinking.
That little girl barely looked 11... why on earth was she living in such a miserable place?
At least in the Golden Cloud City there were several orphanages to take care of these children.
"Tell me little girl, what is this Blue Crow Gang?"
"Oh, they’re the worst!" Little Yao gritted her teeth, her voice slightly shaky.
"They took my mommy and daddy and robbed our house... if it wasn’t for them, i-if it wasn’t for them..." Soon the little girl found herself sobbing again.
Qingxue finally moved, hugging the child and using all the motherly skills she didn’t have to awkwardly console her.

When Yao had controlled her crying, she continued: "The sect even put a bounty on their heads, places to take part in the sect’s selection test, but they have the support from a rich inner disciple, so nobody does anything about them!"
Her voice contained only pain and anger, a feeling that Qingyi understood well.
"You said your family was taken, where exactly?" The handsome young man asked.
He had honestly only helped that little girl because of the moment, he didn’t want to spend too much time on that matter.
But her last words caught his attention.
White Peak City was controlled by the Eternal River Sect, one of the nine great sects of the Nine Peaks basin.
It was among the weakest of the nine, but it still had a powerful Transcendence Realm expert who had lived for over three thousand years.
Such power was not something to be ignored, and entering it often required letters of recommendation that only the richest and noblest could get.
Even though they were just test slots, with no guarantees, they were still valuable opportunities for him and Qingxue.
After a moment’s reflection, Qingyi made his decision.
He would help this little girl, even if it was only for his own gain.
"To the spirit crystal mines," Little Yao replied, her voice losing strength as more bad memories surfaced in her mind. "They take everyone there..."
"Very well." Qingyi stood up and waved his hand in the air.
The next moment, a piece of candy appeared in his hand, capturing the girl’s attention.
When Qingyi held out the candy to her, Yao quickly took it, devouring it with ferocity.
"Thank you, expert!" She bowed again, still licking her fingers.
"You can call me Qingyi," the handsome young man laughed, grabbing Qingxue’s hips and pulling her against him. "This is Qingxue, my wife. We’re going after your family."
Qingxue blushed deeply, but didn’t push Qingyi away, just trying to maintain her posture.
"Ah... thank you big brother Qingyi and big sister Qingxue! Little Yao promises to do her best to repay you!" The girl shouted, drawing a smile from both of them.
For the rest of the afternoon, they stayed by her side.
Qingyi even brought Elize out of the world of Ruxue’s mind, watching with satisfaction as the purple-haired beauty spoiled the girl with all the best she could cook.
He also took the opportunity to ask as many questions as possible about the Blue Crow Gang.
They were a relatively new group and unknown to the city guard.
Their leader was an expert who had advanced to the Crystalline Core Realm a few months ago and had begun his reign of terror.
Little Yao’s family were merchants who refused to pay protection fees and were therefore retaliated against by being kidnapped and sent to the spirit crystal mines.
Qingyi and Qingxue wanted to take Little Yao with them, protecting her until they dealt with that gang, but the little girl refused to leave the house.
Fortunately, with the help of Elize’s food, they managed to make her go to Ruxue’s world of the mind, where she could stay until they could find her parents.

paragraphs: Qingyi raised his gaze, ignoring the trembling of the attendant next to him.
Ten cultivators of the Burning Blood Realm, the strongest among them was at the seventh stage.
That was a frightening power, enough to conquer any kingdom in the outer region of the Blue Moon Continent.
Despite this power, Qingyi didn’t even react to their presence.
With the new power of his bloodline and constitution, not even those in the crystalline core realm gave him fear.
"Husband... can I deal with them?" Qingxue asked and before Qingyi could answer, she was already on her feet.
"D-dear customers... I must r-remind you that destroying parts of the city in fights between cultivators is a crime punishable by death." The attendant stammered.
Cultivators of the Burning Blood Realm were far from being the peak of power in the Nine Peaks Basin.
But they were still feared existences, forming the base of cultivators and with enough power to sweep away an entire city block if they fought with maximum power.
Naturally, legislation for this was needed, otherwise any fight between cultivators would end up with the cities reduced to rubble.
"Don’t worry, my Qingxue knows how to control her power well." Qingyi laughed confidently.
"Stay back, woman." Uncle Wei growled as his eyes roamed over Qingxue’s curves.
"After we deal with your little husband, we’ll take care of you, hahaha-"
Uncle Wei’s laughter was suddenly interrupted.
All he saw was a flash of light as Qingxue drew her white sword.
In the next moment, the old man fell to the ground, blood pooling in his mouth and forcing him to cough, a piece of his tongue falling onto the tavern floor.
Silence immediately filled the entire tavern.
There were many cultivators of the Burning Blood Realm there and they could sense Qingxue’s cultivation very well.
The first stage of the Burning Blood Realm, and one who had recently advanced and whose base was still unstable.
Even so, she was able to cut out the tongue of a cultivator with a cultivation far superior to her own without the latter even being able to notice.
Just... how fast was that frightening woman?
Uncle Wei tried to speak, but all he could make were incomprehensible noises as he pulled a pill out of his space ring, trying to swallow it.
"I didn’t give you permission to heal yourself, insect." Qingxue spoke, her voice cold and full of disdain as she swung her sword once more.
This time, both of the old man’s hands fell to the ground, eliciting an even more miserable scream from him as he painted everything around him vibrant red.
"S-shit, what are you waiting for? Kill that bitch!" Bao roared, taking a cowardly step backwards.
His men hesitated for a brief moment before advancing, unleashing all their power towards Qingxue.
The silver-haired beauty was undeterred, moving the Qi of her bloodline.
Her body was taken over by a subtle transformation as her already absurd speed increased even more.
A single second was all it took before the auras of the Burning Blood Realm around her ceased.
Her double swords became a blur as they tore through the air, her wind Qi leaving the blade and tearing holes in the enemy’s defenses, just enough for her sword Qi to slit their throats.
Her eyes remained indifferent as ten corpses fell to the ground.
With a soft sigh, she put her swords away, looking at her delicate hands.
It was still a little strange for her to get used to the idea of being able to cross so many cultivation realms with such ease.
But beyond the strangeness, there was a pleasant feeling of ecstasy, something she hadn’t felt for a long time.
She turned around, ready to return to Qingyi’s side, but stopped as a powerful aura spread through the tavern.
"Stop right there!" A female voice echoed as a voluptuous figure entered the tavern.
It was a woman from the Nascent Soul Realm. Her beauty, although much wilder, was in no way inferior to that of Qingxue.
Her beautiful face was adorned by piercing green eyes, short flaming hair framing her mature features and fair skin, clearly touched by the sun, but still perfect.

Her delicate torso was protected by a red suit of armor, the steel clinging to the curve of her breasts and her slender waist before widening around her hips, from where a long, elegant skirt descended.
The fine silk fabric sank into the deep valley between her huge, perfectly round buttocks.
Such a figure obviously immediately caught Qingyi’s attention.
Her breasts might be unimpressive, but her bottom certainly made up for it.
The moment the woman took her first step forward, ten guards appeared behind her, all at the crystalline core realm.
On their chests, they bore the symbol of White Peak City.
Her sight swept over all the customers, past the corpses on the ground and landed on Qingyi and Qingxue.
Her eyes flickered gently as they met Qingyi’s, black, beautiful and penetrating, seeming to be able to see her very soul.
She controlled the soft blush that appeared on her cheeks before focusing her mind again.
"I am Zhu Rongyan, captain of the third regiment of the White Peak City Guard. Explain yourselves!" she roared.
"Greetings, senior." Long Qingyi stood up, bowing to Rongyan and clasping his fists respectfully.
"This little one is Long Qingyi, and this is my wife, Xu Qingxue. These are bandits from the Blue Crow Gang and they attacked us first, we only acted in self-defense."
He explained, his eyes shining as he looked at the woman’s information screen.
