chapters.title: Chapter 183 - Little Yao misses you
paragraphs: Qingyi waited patiently outside the cave.
After a few moments, the first figure appeared.
It was a thin, tall man, his face riddled with scars as a powerful flaming Qi surrounded him.
He was clearly an expert of the crystalline core realm.
"You, who the hell are you?" The skinny man questioned, his eyes filled with murderous intent as he saw his men lying dead on the ground.
Dozens more figures appeared behind him, surrounding Qingyi completely.
"Brat..." The skinny man growled, his crystalline core realm aura exploding, taking in everything in a radius of more than ten meters. "Better start explaining yourself."
"Bao." Qingyi said a single word, but it was enough to completely shatter the skinny man’s composure.
A soft, gentle smile took over Qingyi’s face, clearly not matching his words. "I would have liked to kill your little brother myself, but my wife took the honor."
"You son of a bitch! You’ll pay for this!" The skinny man finally exploded as he roared, his voice more like that of an animal than a man.
A fire tornado danced around his fists, the flames rising tens of meters high, the ground beneath his feet turning black under the heat.
He lunged forward.
Qingyi was more than a hundred meters away, but he only needed a fraction of a second to get in front of the handsome young man.
"DIE!" The skinny man punched.
A deafening bang echoed as the Qi of fire and lightning sword met.
The shockwave destroyed everything within a radius of fifty meters, knocking down the weakest trees and defoliating the sturdiest ones.
A cloud of dust and steam rose up, blinding the men of the Blue Crow gang who were watching the fight with excited looks on their faces.
It was rare to see their leader fight and everyone wanted a good show.
When the dust began to settle, they expected to see their boss beating up that pretty face, but unfortunately for them, it wasn’t that sight that greeted them.
Qingyi was standing still, having taken a single step backwards.
The heaven-defying thunder sword had passed through the skinny man’s defenses as if they were nothing, ripping his fist in half, the purplish-silver blade reaching all the way to his wrist.
"Argh... fuck!" The skinny man’s eyes widened as the pain woke up his hate-drunk mind.
He tried desperately to retreat, but Qingyi didn’t allow him to.
The heaven-defying thunder sword tore through the air with a sharp hiss, striking the skinny man’s legs and slicing through flesh, and bone, tearing off both legs in a single movement.
" Damn, the leader’s screwed!" One of the bandits shouted, making the few neurons in his companions work.
This was not an enemy they could defeat.
"Fucking run!" They split up, running everywhere.
"I haven’t given anyone permission to move here." Qingyi’s cold, soft voice echoed.
In the next moment, his draconic Qi exploded out of his Dantian, the air around him becoming heavy as a colossal figure stood at his back.
Its huge mouth full of sharp teeth opened in a bestial grunt as large purple eyes fell on the criminals.
Nobody moved, not that they didn’t want to.
Their Qi and their bodies simply refused to respond.
Raising their vision, they saw the figure of the black dragon’s head above Qingyi and their hearts immediately filled with terror.
"I was hoping to use you to try out a new technique in real combat, but I understand that I shouldn’t expect too much from filthy insects like you."
"W-what the hell did we do to you? What do you want? Ugh... SHIT!" The skinny man whimpered, using his only functional hand to grab one of his severed legs.
Qingyi knelt down in front of him.
"I’m after a couple of merchants you kidnapped. A middle-aged man with a birthmark on his neck and a blonde woman with a small scar on her chin.
Despite hearing Qingyi’s words, the skinny man didn’t reply immediately, confining himself to muffled sniffles as he tried to crawl away from Qingyi.
"Answer me." The handsome young man punched, breaking a few of the skinny man’s teeth.
"I don’t fucking know! There must be hundreds of people there, I don’t know everyone’s face."
"Then you have no use." Qingyi swung his sword, decapitating the leader of the blue crow gang.
Looking at the rest, he used the second form of the Tempest Monarch’s sword art.
No matter how many pleading looks he received, he felt no pity.
He knew well that each of them had killed at least a dozen people and if left alive, they would kill many, many hundreds until they were finally killed.
A blade of thunderous Qi rose as Qingyi’s sword cut through the air, leaving a trail of destruction wherever it went.
For more than a hundred meters around him, tree trunks fell heavily to the forest floor, accompanied by the corpses of all the members of the blue crow gang.
Ignoring the scene in front of him, Qingyi merely stowed the skinny man’s head in his space ring before entering the stuffy cave.
He was immediately greeted by the sight of a corridor leading to a large pocket where more than five hundred people were mining non-stop.
’This is going to be harder than I thought...’ Qingyi sighed inwardly before shouting, taking the workers’ attention.
"Your captors are dead, I have released them." He showed the decapitated head of the leader of the Blue Crow mercenaries.
The workers stopped mining immediately, casting glances in the direction of the handsome young man.
At first they watched them suspiciously, but that suspicion soon turned to relief as their pickaxes and buckets of spirit crystals fell to the ground.
"I need your help to find someone." Qingyi exclaimed, before asking all the miners, men, women and even children to line up.
Turning on his draconic eyes, he observed the faces of each of them until he finally stopped at a tired-looking couple.
With a smooth movement, Qingyi jumped onto the platform where they stood, a smile playing on his lips as he spoke. "Little Yao misses you."

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - Little Yao’s family
paragraphs: "Ah..." A bored sigh escaped Rongyan’s full, red lips.
She was in her office at the headquarters of the city guard, an enormous fortress that rose over twenty stories and housed almost five thousand guards.
Her shapely buttocks rested on a leather armchair while her head lay on a pile of documents on her desk.
It had been a few months since she had finally managed to become captain of the third regiment of the imperial guard, her life’s goal.
But nothing had gone as she had hoped.
She didn’t see a single crime worthy of her eyes, no great thieves, no murderers worth her time.
Some gangs even caused problems, but she simply couldn’t act on some bullshit about the dignity of a captain of the guard.
All she could do there was sign an endless pile of documents, hoping that someday a mission would come her way.
"I miss fighting with my brothers over food on my parents’ farm..." Rongyan whispered words she thought she would never repeat in her life as she stood up.
Walking over to her office window, she looked out at the city below, remembering the face of her superior.
"Ah, a woman of your rank shouldn’t lower herself to such lowly tasks, nhe nhe nhe, leave it to the common guards." She forced out an annoying nasal voice while imitating that damned old man.
"Captain!" A powerful voice echoed followed by a loud knock, drawing a startled squeal from Rongyan.
Her whole body shook and her hands accidentally hit a porcelain vase.
"Fuck!" She regained her composure, grabbing the vase centimeters before it hit the ground.
Putting it back, she sighed with relief.
These things were expensive and she had already lost almost half her salary for having a burst of anger and destroying the entire office.
She didn’t want to go through that again.
"Captain, there’s someone looking for you. He said you asked him to find you to deliver a mission."
"Ask him to come in." Rongyan returned to her chair, a certain strangeness shining on her face as she tried to remember who this person might be.
Her face blushed slightly as she remembered a handsome young man with long black hair and a penetrating gaze.
Could it be that young man?
’No... it’s impossible, how could he’- Rongyan’s thoughts were interrupted when the door to her office opened.
"Greetings, Senior Rongyan, this humble one has already dealt with the Blue Crow Gang." Qingyi bowed respectfully before taking a head out of his spatial ring.

"You killed him alone and without any artifacts? Where’s your wife?" She picked up the decapitated head, observing its features and pulling out a document from her desk drawer, confirming that it was the right person.
"Yes, Captain. Qingxue is cultivating behind closed doors."
Even after hearing that answer, it was still hard for Rongyan to believe. But in the end, she just shook her head.
How Qingyi killed wasn’t her problem and even if it was, the leader of that gang was a weakling, even compared to people of lower cultivation than his.
"Right," she nodded, putting the criminal’s head away and starting to write on a document.
Qingyi just waited silently, giving Rongyan some more information before leaving.
He didn’t worry too much about rescuing the other people, they didn’t really matter to him and all he did was point out the area where they were, leaving that to the guards.
Stopping in his tracks, he closed his eyes, entering Ruxue’s world of mind.
He was immediately greeted by animated laughter as he passed through the temple gates.
He saw little Yao sitting on Ruxue’s lap, her old, torn clothes replaced by an elegant purple dress made by the lightning spirit herself.
Her little feet tapped excitedly as Elize put a piece of cake in her mouth.
"I told you I was her favorite, fufufu~~" Ruxue turned her face away as she hugged little Yao tightly.
Qingyi’s face darkened, watching little Yao’s gaze. Had she really chosen Ruxue over Elize and Feiyan? How was that possible?
"Big brother Qingyi!" A big smile appeared on little Yao’s face as she stood up, running over to him.
"How are you, little one? Do you like it here?" he asked gently, keeping useless thoughts away..
"Yes, everyone is very nice to me! hehehe" She gave a little laugh that could melt the heart of even the bitterest man.
Qingyi returned her smile before stroking her hair.
It was a little difficult to pull her out of the priestesses’ arms, but in the end, he still managed to do it, taking the little girl back to the outside world before going after Qingxue.
She was a little surprised to see Qingyi so soon, but in the end, she just grabbed little Yao’s hand and together, they made their way to one of the middle-class areas of the city.
"Big Brother Qingyi, Big Sister Qingxue, where are we going?" Little Yao asked curiously, her big eyes studying the surrounding houses and vaguely recognizing them.
"You’ll see soon enough." Qingyi smiled and after a few more blocks, they turned left, stopping in front of a humble house.
Seemed to have been abandoned for many months, but it was still cozy and warm.
Little Yao stopped, her eyes fluttered and she took a step forward.
This was the house she used to live in with her parents before the Blue Crow gang took everything from them.
After a moment’s hesitation, she grabbed the door handle and entered the house, her vision soon focusing on a couple sitting in the living room.
Their eyes were tired and they had just had their first shower in weeks.
"Daddy?... Mommy?..." The little girl whispered.
It was only when her mother returned that sweet, warm smile she had missed so much that she finally broke down completely.
Qingyi just watched from afar, grabbing Qingxue’s wide hips and pulling her against him.
"You look disappointed..." Qingyi murmured, observing the bitter expression on Qingxue’s face.
"I’m not, I just..." She tried to find words to explain herself, but couldn’t.
"Don’t be so selfish, the time will come for us to have our own." Qingyi smiled, placing a soft kiss on Qingxue’s lips.
The silver-haired beauty blushed, snuggling into her husband’s arms while little Yao threw herself into her parents’ arms.
After a moment’s hesitation, Qingxue asked.
"My father had hundreds of wives and dozens of children, abandoning anyone who wasn’t worthy of his gaze... You’re not going to be like that, are you?"
"No." Qingyi shook his head. "I’ll love them all, I promise."
Soon after the crying subsided, Qingyi approached little Yao’s parents, handing them a small bag.

He had taken the skinny man’s space ring and although it didn’t have much, he had still managed to get over a thousand spirit crystals, giving fifty of them to little Yao’s family to help them get their business back on its feet.
It was a small amount for cultivators, but a true fortune for mortals.
Waving farewell to Little Yao, his eyes lifted to a mountain on the horizon, white as snow and rising thousands of meters high.
It was time to get ready to join the Eternal river sect.

sentences.text: "Ah..." A bored sigh escaped Rongyan’s full, red lips.
She was in her office at the headquarters of the city guard, an enormous fortress that rose over twenty stories and housed almost five thousand guards.
Her shapely buttocks rested on a leather armchair while her head lay on a pile of documents on her desk.
It had been a few months since she had finally managed to become captain of the third regiment of the imperial guard, her life’s goal.
But nothing had gone as she had hoped.
She didn’t see a single crime worthy of her eyes, no great thieves, no murderers worth her time.
Some gangs even caused problems, but she simply couldn’t act on some bullshit about the dignity of a captain of the guard.
All she could do there was sign an endless pile of documents, hoping that someday a mission would come her way.
"I miss fighting with my brothers over food on my parents’ farm..." Rongyan whispered words she thought she would never repeat in her life as she stood up.
Walking over to her office window, she looked out at the city below, remembering the face of her superior.
"Ah, a woman of your rank shouldn’t lower herself to such lowly tasks, nhe nhe nhe, leave it to the common guards." She forced out an annoying nasal voice while imitating that damned old man.
"Captain!" A powerful voice echoed followed by a loud knock, drawing a startled squeal from Rongyan.
Her whole body shook and her hands accidentally hit a porcelain vase.
"Fuck!" She regained her composure, grabbing the vase centimeters before it hit the ground.
Putting it back, she sighed with relief.
These things were expensive and she had already lost almost half her salary for having a burst of anger and destroying the entire office.
She didn’t want to go through that again.
"Captain, there’s someone looking for you.
He said you asked him to find you to deliver a mission."
"Ask him to come in." Rongyan returned to her chair, a certain strangeness shining on her face as she tried to remember who this person might be.
Her face blushed slightly as she remembered a handsome young man with long black hair and a penetrating gaze.
Could it be that young man?
’No... it’s impossible, how could he’- Rongyan’s thoughts were interrupted when the door to her office opened.
"Greetings, Senior Rongyan, this humble one has already dealt with the Blue Crow Gang." Qingyi bowed respectfully before taking a head out of his spatial ring.
"You killed him alone and without any artifacts?
Where’s your wife?" She picked up the decapitated head, observing its features and pulling out a document from her desk drawer, confirming that it was the right person.
"Yes, Captain.
Qingxue is cultivating behind closed doors."
Even after hearing that answer, it was still hard for Rongyan to believe.
But in the end, she just shook her head.
How Qingyi killed wasn’t her problem and even if it was, the leader of that gang was a weakling, even compared to people of lower cultivation than his.
"Right," she nodded, putting the criminal’s head away and starting to write on a document.
Qingyi just waited silently, giving Rongyan some more information before leaving.
He didn’t worry too much about rescuing the other people, they didn’t really matter to him and all he did was point out the area where they were, leaving that to the guards.
Stopping in his tracks, he closed his eyes, entering Ruxue’s world of mind.
He was immediately greeted by animated laughter as he passed through the temple gates.
He saw little Yao sitting on Ruxue’s lap, her old, torn clothes replaced by an elegant purple dress made by the lightning spirit herself.
Her little feet tapped excitedly as Elize put a piece of cake in her mouth.
"I told you I was her favorite, fufufu~~" Ruxue turned her face away as she hugged little Yao tightly.
Qingyi’s face darkened, watching little Yao’s gaze.
Had she really chosen Ruxue over Elize and Feiyan?
How was that possible?
"Big brother Qingyi!" A big smile appeared on little Yao’s face as she stood up, running over to him.
"How are you, little one?
Do you like it here?" he asked gently, keeping useless thoughts away..
"Yes, everyone is very nice to me! hehehe" She gave a little laugh that could melt the heart of even the bitterest man.
Qingyi returned her smile before stroking her hair.
It was a little difficult to pull her out of the priestesses’ arms, but in the end, he still managed to do it, taking the little girl back to the outside world before going after Qingxue.
She was a little surprised to see Qingyi so soon, but in the end, she just grabbed little Yao’s hand and together, they made their way to one of the middle-class areas of the city.
"Big Brother Qingyi, Big Sister Qingxue, where are we going?" Little Yao asked curiously, her big eyes studying the surrounding houses and vaguely recognizing them.
"You’ll see soon enough." Qingyi smiled and after a few more blocks, they turned left, stopping in front of a humble house.
Seemed to have been abandoned for many months, but it was still cozy and warm.
Little Yao stopped, her eyes fluttered and she took a step forward.
This was the house she used to live in with her parents before the Blue Crow gang took everything from them.
After a moment’s hesitation, she grabbed the door handle and entered the house, her vision soon focusing on a couple sitting in the living room.
Their eyes were tired and they had just had their first shower in weeks.
"Daddy?...
Mommy?..." The little girl whispered.
It was only when her mother returned that sweet, warm smile she had missed so much that she finally broke down completely.
Qingyi just watched from afar, grabbing Qingxue’s wide hips and pulling her against him.
"You look disappointed..." Qingyi murmured, observing the bitter expression on Qingxue’s face.
"I’m not, I just..." She tried to find words to explain herself, but couldn’t.
"Don’t be so selfish, the time will come for us to have our own." Qingyi smiled, placing a soft kiss on Qingxue’s lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - Zhao Yulei
paragraphs: "Congratulations on your breakthrough to the ninth stage of the crystalline core realm, young master Zhao!"
An excited voice echoed from a private room in one of the most expensive taverns in the entire red light district of White Peak City.
The owner of the voice prostrated himself to a tall, handsome man with broad shoulders, short golden hair and a sharp face.
He was Zhao Yulei, son of the grand elder of one of the seven great families and one of the thousand most talented young people among the entire younger generation of the nine peaks basin.
He was sitting on a large couch with two prostitutes in his arms.
"No need to be so polite, Brother Gurye, we’ve known each other too long to treat each other like this!" Yulei laughed honestly as he waved Gurye over to sit next to him.
"Thank you, Brother Yulei." Gurye returned the smile before sitting down.
"Tell me, brother, what brings you here? How are the mines?" Yulei asked, taking a long sip from his glass of liquor.
"Well, this week’s shipment was good, hahaha." Gurye smiled, throwing a space ring in Yulei’s direction, but that smile soon faded.
"But... we had a little problem."
Yulei turned his face away, watching Gurye with an intense gaze. "What problem?"
"The blue crow gang, a son of a bitch killed them and the city guard confiscated the mine."
A loud crack echoed as the porcelain cup shattered in Yulei’s hands, drawing a scream from the prostitutes in his arms.
"I remember very well ordering you to bribe the guards, what the hell did you do with the money I gave you?" Yulei stood up and the prostitutes ran out of the room as his Qi exploded.
"I bribed them, young master Yulei! I promise! They’re not the ones who attacked the Blue Crow gang."
"THEN WHO DID IT?" Yulei roared as he stomped on the floor, the whole building shaking with his anger.
"It was that bitch from the third regiment, wasn’t it? Ugh... I told my father to be against the appointment of that damned peasant, why the hell doesn’t that old man listen to me?"
"N-not her, young master, but a bastard who was seen next to her, a pretty face called Qingyi! My spies have heard that he’ll be taking part in the sect selection!"
"Qingyi..." Yulei repeated in his mind. "You’ll pay for getting involved in my affairs.
"Notify the sect that I’ll be taking part in this year’s selection as flag bearer," Yulei turned around.
"Will young master Yulei forgive me?" Gurye raised his face, once full of fear and now filled with a glimmer of hope.
"I wasn’t talking to you." Zhao Yulei left.
The next moment, Gurye saw a shadow appear on the ground and a powerful hand clutching his neck.
Both the Ascending Dragon Sect and the Eternal River Sect were mountainside sects, with the Eternal River Sect taking one of the nine peaks that gave the Nine Peaks Basin its name for itself.
The biggest difference between them was their size.

Unlike the ascending dragon sect, which was inside the city of golden clouds and had just over ten thousand disciples, the white peak sect was kilometers away from the city of white peak, reaching over a hundred thousand disciples.
It was divided into three main zones.
The first was the outer zone, a forest that stretched for thousands of kilometers and, outside the few protected zones, was full of powerful spirit beasts.
The second was the inner zone, where inner disciples, outer disciples and the sect’s main infrastructures were located.
The third was the heart of the sect, protected by elders of the rebirth realm and core disciples of the nascent soul realm, plus, of course, the sect leader and the guardian.
The latter two were among the few existences in the entire Blue Moon Continent who would be able to live for more than ten thousand years and open mountains at will.
Beings of the transcendental realm.
At this very moment, the outer zone was being prepared for the sect’s annual selection.
As the White Peak Sect only recruited with recommendations and only in very rare cases opened the tests to anyone, there were few participants, only a little over a thousand.
They were all gathered in a large courtyard in front of the sect gates.

"Thank you for leading us here, Captain Rongyan," Qingyi spoke, his eyes focused on the gentle sway of the red-haired beauty’s hips as she walked, each step causing sensual tremors to spread through her voluptuous, succulent ass.
"It’s nothing." She smiled softly as she stopped her steps.
"See it as a thank you for finishing off those bastards. I was tired of ordering my men to deal with them and getting nothing but failure."
Her eyes suddenly twitched as they focused on one of the fifty inner disciples at the top of the gate.
This was a figure she knew very well, and whose eyes were focused on her and Qingyi.
She glanced to the side, realizing that Qingyi had also noticed that look.

"I should go now. That’s the one suspected of sponsoring the Blue Crow gang. Be careful with him, he’s from one of the seven great families and his father is one of the most powerful men in White Peak City." Rongyan warned, receiving a positive nod from Qingyi.
The seven great families...
Tang Biyue was from one of these seven great families and as far as he knew, one of the strongest of the seven.
’I just hope she doesn’t try to kill me,’ Qingyi thought.
It was still his goal to take her as his wife, he just didn’t know how he would do it yet without dying immediately.
Suddenly, a murmur went up from the cultivators waiting to be selected for the Eternal River Sect.
Looking up, Qingyi saw a colossal figure tearing through the sky, leaving a trail of flames.
It was a Giant Tiger, but it didn’t seemed to be a spiritual beast.
Its fur was a deep orange, its body towering over five meters tall while its feline face bore dignified features.
It landed above the sect gates, its deep, flaming eyes watching the young cultivators below.
It was hundreds of meters away, but Qingyi could still feel the waves of heat hitting his face.
He was sure that the beast was holding back a lot, but even a fraction of a fraction of its power was enough to make the world around him change completely.
"A mythical beast..." Qingxue whispered next to Qingyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - just don’t beg when I start knocking your teeth out
paragraphs: Mystical beasts, despite their similar appearance, were completely different from spirit beasts, having intelligence and speech capabilities similar to, if not superior to humans.
Most of the nine great sects and seven great families had one mystical beast as a guardian.
"I am Yanxiao, guardian of the Eternal River Sect," the tiger spoke.
His voice was masculine, deep and calm , carrying the dignity of an emperor.

"The elder assigned to test you is unfortunately unable to attend. Normally, a lower level instructor would take care of this matter, but I have decided to take on this position this year," Yanxiao spoke again.
Those words immediately raised hushed whispers among the crowd.
The guardian giving the sect’s selection test?
No one there had ever heard of anything like that. But for many there, just seeing the guardian, a being of the transcendent realm, was worth it, so they didn’t question it.

"None of you would be here without proving your worth, so I won’t delay you with pointless talent tests." With a smooth movement, the tiger leapt towards the platform where the young people to be selected were standing.
Following him, the fifty inner disciples above the gate also jumped.
The moment the tiger landed on the platform, the air temperature rose rapidly, its mere presence forcing everyone to retreat.
"But first, I need to thin out their numbers a bit."
The tiger’s large, sharp claws tore through the marble of the platform and as the fifty inner disciples stopped beside it.
Its aura exploded from its body, a burning heat spreading throughout the platform as it used just over 1% of its power.
Gritting his teeth, Qingyi circulated his Qi. He shuddered slightly, but his constitution was able to withstand it.
Turning his face, he looked at the silver-haired beauty.
Qingxue was panting, drops of sweat running down the deep valley of her breasts as her legs trembled.
But she forced herself to be strong, using her wind Qi to cool herself down as much as possible while resisting.
It wasn’t long before the number of young people began to fall.
When the number of young people reached half, Yanxiao’s large feline face lit up in a bestial smile and he released the pressure.
"Very well, that number should do." Yanxiao scratched the ground once more and the space around them distorted, the ground beneath their feet seeming to disappear as the world around them changed.
When they felt their feet beneath them again, they found themselves in a large grassy plain surrounded by a dense forest.
’A teleportation formation, and a powerful one...’ Qingyi’s eyes widened.
Such formations did exist in the outer region, the Ascending Dragon Sect itself had one, but it couldn’t take more than five low-level cultivators or a single elder.
He could only imagine the amount of energy needed to be able to transport more than five hundred cultivators of the Burning Blood Realm like that.
"Guardian, can you explain to us exactly what the tests will be this year?" One of the young cultivators asked, his luxurious clothes fluttering as he stepped forward.
"Yes, where is the three level test?" another spoke up, also with noble features and clothes.
"Have patience, little ones. I’ve received permission from the sect leader to do this test my way, so we’ll skip straight to the flags test." Yanxiao turned his face towards the inner disciples.
"These will be the inner disciples who will evaluate you. Their cultivation may seem a little intimidating, but don’t worry, they are here to evaluate you and not to defeat you.
They will each have a flag and will be distributed randomly throughout the forest. They are only allowed to defend, not attack.
Once you’ve taken the flag, just bring it back to this spot and as you can imagine, only fifty of you will pass."
Yanxiao explained as he knocked on the ground and a pillar carrying a crystal ball rose up in front of him.
"Any questions?" he asked.
"Actually I-"
"Perfect," Yanxiao interrupted the young man who was trying to speak. "Line up, this orb will send you to random parts of the forest."
Following Yanxiao’s words, the five hundred challengers formed a line, Qingyi and Qingxue standing two places apart.
[Good luck]
Qingxue’s sweet, serene voice sounded in Qingyi’s ears via sound transmission as she placed her hands on the orb.
Her body immediately disappeared in a beam of light.
Qingyi stepped forward soon after, raising his vision and meeting the eyes of Zhao Yulei, who looked ready to eat him alive.
[I hope I fall into the same zone as you.]
Zhao Yulei sent a sound transmission to Qingyi, unable to contain his murderous intent.
To his surprise, Qingyi only smiled softly in response.
[Me too, just don’t beg when I start knocking your teeth out]
Soon, Qingyi’s body also disappeared in a beam of light, leaving Zhao Yulei stunned behind.
How could that damned commoner dare to speak to him like that?
The tiger noticed their exchange, but just ignored it and the moment he found himself alone on the marble platform, he leapt upwards, his body taking flight as his flaming Qi surrounded him.
breaking the sound barrier and continuing to double his speed again and again, it didn’t take long for him to soar beyond the clouds.

"See? I told you I could still do it, hahaha! My efficiency is unmatched!" Yanxiao laughed as his huge body appeared next to a woman whose appearance was covered by a veil, floating subtly above a small cloud.
Her curves showed beauty, unlike the little skin she had visible, her hands were covered in horrible scars, as were her lips that drank from a cup of tea.
She looked as if she had been bathed in fire, her skin melting into her flesh and bones.
"In fact, it’s unmatched - one of the worst I’ve ever seen, fufufu~~" The woman laughed, her voice calm and charming.
"Worst? Woman, I already used to do those things when your grandfather - no, when your grandfather’s grandfather wore diapers."
"That was many tens of millennia ago."
"Yes, but I still haven’t lost my touch." Yanxiao looked away, his pride clearly wounded.
Suddenly, Yanxiao’s gaze changed.
To ensure fairness, the flag bearers had been divided equally throughout the forest and they were not allowed to move.
Yet one of them was moving.
"Let me guess, it’s the young Zhao boy?" The woman spoke, noticing the change in the tiger’s gaze.

"Who else?" Yanxiao growled. "Honestly, what the hell was in your head when you came up with that policy of avoiding intervening in the affairs of the great families and giving the disciples so much freedom?"
"My head? That was nine thousand years ago, I wasn’t even born yet."
"Uh... Sometimes I forget how little you humans live." Yanxiao shook his head.
"We were one of the most powerful sects, we endured the last demon war and the other two that came before it, I myself have already beheaded a celestial demon with my own teeth.
I still remember the disgusting taste of that son of a bitch’s blood.
Even so, a single change of policy was all it took for us to become the weakest of the nine great sects. Sometimes I regret promising your ancestor not to intervene in the sect’s politics."
Hearing Yanxiao’s words, the woman just took another sip from her cup of tea.
"Just watch. If necessary, intervene."
"As the sect leader wishes."

The tiger noticed their exchange, but just ignored it and the moment he found himself alone on the marble platform, he leapt upwards, his body taking flight as his flaming Qi surrounded him.
breaking the sound barrier and continuing to double his speed again and again, it didn’t take long for him to soar beyond the clouds.
"See?
I told you I could still do it, hahaha!
My efficiency is unmatched!" Yanxiao laughed as his huge body appeared next to a woman whose appearance was covered by a veil, floating subtly above a small cloud.
Her curves showed beauty, unlike the little skin she had visible, her hands were covered in horrible scars, as were her lips that drank from a cup of tea.
She looked as if she had been bathed in fire, her skin melting into her flesh and bones.
"In fact, it’s unmatched - one of the worst I’ve ever seen, fufufu~~" The woman laughed, her voice calm and charming.
"Worst?
Woman, I already used to do those things when your grandfather - no, when your grandfather’s grandfather wore diapers."
"That was many tens of millennia ago."
"Yes, but I still haven’t lost my touch." Yanxiao looked away, his pride clearly wounded.
Suddenly, Yanxiao’s gaze changed.
To ensure fairness, the flag bearers had been divided equally throughout the forest and they were not allowed to move.
Yet one of them was moving.

"My head?
That was nine thousand years ago, I wasn’t even born yet."
Sometimes I forget how little you humans live." Yanxiao shook his head.

I still remember the disgusting taste of that son of a bitch’s blood.
Even so, a single change of policy was all it took for us to become the weakest of the nine great sects.
Sometimes I regret promising your ancestor not to intervene in the sect’s politics."

"As the sect leader wishes."

Probably no one below the crystalline core realm could compare to her speed.
Qingyi stepped forward, ready to activate his lightning steps, but stopped suddenly.
His eyes glowed a deep purple and the heaven-defying thunder sword slid out of its sheath with a sharp hiss, immediately enveloped in a thunderous aura.

The young master of the Zhao family was catapulted backwards, his body bouncing on the ground for dozens of meters before coming to a stop, falling onto his knees.
"S-shit." Yulei spat out a gulp of blood, his panting breath revealing a few broken front teeth.
"How dare you!" he shouted, his voice trembling as his Qi exploded and thunderous lightning took over his body. "I’ll make you pay for this a thousand times over!"
He was also a cultivator with a lightning spirit root.
Qingyi only smiled in response, but didn’t dare let his guard down.
Without using his bloodline projection, he doubted very much that his combat capabilities would be able to go beyond the second or third stage of the crystalline core realm.

The ground sank into a crater as the lightning that danced around their blades exploded everywhere, knocking down trees and making the air around them boil.

Five steps.
He had just been forced back five steps by a cultivator two realms below his?
Shock soon turned to shame, and that shame immediately turned into enough anger to make him tremble.
"I was only planning to cripple you, but now I’m going to kill you, and then I’ll go after that silver-haired whore who accompanies you... with her beauty..."
Yulei’s face was filled with lust. "She’ll make a good wife - no, a good sex toy for me and all my men!"
Yulei readied his blade, ready to use his family’s strongest offensive lightning technique, but before he could even manifest it in his blade, his whole body froze.
His Qi stopped responding and his legs failed him.
Qingyi closed his eyes.
Yulei’s first words had already made his heart fill with rage.
But the last ones? That changed everything.
"I’d really... really just make you toothless and maybe give you some broken fingers." Qingyi tried and failed to contain his fury.
Even without his command, his draconic Qi moved.
A colossal figure appeared on his back, its guttural, bestial growl echoing through the forest and making every hair on the body of every cultivator within a kilometer radius stand on end.
"But I’ve changed my mind. Pigs like you should be castrated."
"W-what?"Yulei was unable to hide the tremor in his voice and the terror in his eyes as he watched the beast behind Qingyi.
There was no nobility nor dignity, nothing but the purest representation of fear and fury.
Beyond lust and desire, that was what a black dragon stood for.
"D-don’t come any closer! D-do you know who my father is?" Yulei asked, taking trembling steps backwards.
"Hm... let me see... to give birth to a son of a bitch like you..."
Qingyi closed the distance between him and Yulei in a single movement, a blade of Qi appearing in his fingers.
"He’s certainly a disgusting cuckold."
Following Qingyi’s words, a heartbreaking scream echoed throughout the forest as Yulei fell to the ground, an endless stream of blood flowing down between his legs.
Qingyi ignored the screams, kicking Yulei in the face and knocking out the rest of his front teeth.

"you’ve already turned him into a woman, kid, you don’t need to give him a full facial reconstruction as well."
A colossal figure suddenly appeared, its flaming eyes focusing on Qingyi’s lineage projection with interest.
That was one of the most powerful lineages he had ever seen in his life, but he was still a transcendent.
All it took was a single thought and the flow of Qi that fed the projection was broken, causing it to disappear.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - Same smell
paragraphs: Regaining his composure, Qingyi immediately bowed. "This humble one greets the guardian and asks forgiveness for the disrespect!"
"Don’t worry about it, little one." Yanxiao raised a claw and a small flag emerged from Yulei’s clothes, floating into Qingyi’s hands.
"Long Qingyi, right?" Yanxiao smiled.
"Many carry dragon in their name, but few are truly worthy of it.
You’re only the fifth one I’ve met in over sixty thousand years of life. Hahaha."
"The guardian praises this humble one too much." Qingyi said, only to get another laugh from Yanxiao.
" Good, knowing when to be humble is a virtue. Most of those who carry dragon blood barely know the meaning of that word."
Yanxiao paused for a moment, studying Yulei’s unconscious body before shaking his head.
"You can go now, I’ll take care of the rest."
Bowing one last time, Qingyi left.
"Ah... what do you think of this one, Sect Leader?" Yanxiao raised his head.
"A black dragon..." A female voice sounded, sweet, soft and serene, like a heavenly symphony for mortal eardrums. "Have you ever seen one that didn’t represent calamity?"

"I’ve never seen a dragon that didn’t represent calamity, be it black, red, gold or white." Yanxiao shook his head. "This is the only one who managed to defeat a disciple with a flag. We should pay attention to him."
"Not the only one." The Eternal River leader’s cracked and scarred lips curved into a smile as she looked at the horizon.
"Hm... this is a year full of surprises." Yanxiao also smiled and, after a moment’s hesitation, asked: "Why does that boy smell like you?"
"Like me?" The sect leader raised an eyebrow, looking as surprised by this as Yanxiao himself.
"Not exactly, not even his smell in reality, just a smell that is in him. It’s similar to yours, almost identical, like that of a..." The tiger sniffed the air "Sister or brother..."
After these words, Yanxiao watched the sect leader’s expression fade slightly.
He still had some doubts, but his sense of smell didn’t fool him, it never had.
"If there’s nothing more to see here, I’ll leave." The sect leader turned and left immediately.
The tiger just let a muffled sigh escape his lips as he focused on the young master of the Zhao family, whose body soon began to float beside him.
Since the accident 29 years ago, his sect leader had not been the same as the one he had known for the previous 3,000 years.
Her smell and even her Qi control had changed, as if she had been used to using a completely different type of energy before suddenly needing to use Qi.
It was strange, but he didn’t spend much time thinking about it.
He had to get Yulei to the sect doctor soon.
The fact that Yulei had been castrated was problem enough and Yanxiao really didn’t want to hear the complaints of the patriarch of the Zhao family if that young man died in his hands.
On the platform where the test was to be completed, a solitary figure could be seen.
It was a woman of transcendental beauty, kneeling elegantly on the marble of the platform as she waited, her large bosoms rising with each soft breath.
Around her, several cultivators whimpered as they clutched their severed hands and legs.
These were opportunists, waiting to ambush those who had completed the challenge and steal their flags.
Her long white hair fluttered in the gentle breeze and her face lifted, watching a figure on the horizon.
The coldness in his gaze melted immediately and, without even realizing it, his full, rosy lips lifted into a smile.
"So... yours was easy too?" Qingyi approached, taking Qingxue in his arms, feeling the softness of her breasts pressing against his chest.
"A disgusting fellow, more interested in flirting than fighting," Qingxue replied, snuggling into Qingyi’s embrace.
"I see... mine was a disgusting guy too." Qingyi kissed her before, together, they just watched the horizon.
It wasn’t long before the first to complete the challenge began to appear, almost all of them with their bodies covered in scars, their eyes focused on Qingyi’s figure with envy.
The handsome young man just ignored those stares as he stroked Qingxue’s long silver hair.
After almost three hours of waiting, the more than fifty flags were finally fully retrieved.
There were still fights over the flags taken, especially against those who seemed weaker, but those fights stopped the moment the figure of a giant fire tiger cut through the sky.
"Well done!" The tiger laughed, watching as two figures appeared beside him, a man and a woman.
"As you may already know, your resources will be based on merit and competence." He spoke, the space around him distorting as silver tokens appeared in the air.
They were similar to the tokens offered by the Ascending Dragon sect, both in use and appearance.
The only major difference was the quality and quantity of Qi that each token stored.
Right after handing over the token to each of the disciples, Yanxiao only gave a short, basic explanation of each disciple’s duties and rights.
It wasn’t much different from those of the Ascending Dragon Sect, the only real change was the scale.
After finishing his speech, Yanxiao released the new disciples of the Eternal River Sect, dividing them between the two instructors who would take them to their accommodation.
"You two will stay," Yanxiao said, directing his voice to Qingyi and Qingxue, who stopped their steps.
"Something wrong, guardian?" Qingyi asked.
"No, we just need to talk for a while." Yanxiao turned around. "Come with me."
The couple exchanged glances, but in the end they just nodded and followed the tiger.
"The boy you castrated, do you know who he is?" Yanxiao asked, looking at Qingyi.
Those words immediately made Qingxue shudder.
What had this miserable fellow done to be castrated by her husband?
"I know his father has a lot of power," Qingyi replied.

"He does. The second most powerful man in the Zhao family, who has taken root in White Peak City like an cancer. Yulei is too proud to ask for his father’s help, but if it happens, you’ll both be in danger."
"I thank you for your concern, guardian. But-"

"I’m going to give you the position of inner disciple. You’ve already proven your power and this position will give you both extra protection." Yanxiao spoke, ignoring Qingyi and Qingxue’s surprised looks.
Inner disciples? So easily?
"Don’t let your pride blind you. It’s a great achievement, but nothing more." Yanxiao focused his gaze on Qingyi specifically.
"The secret realm of the supreme beast will open in a few days. If you’re interested in a spirit mount, I recommend that you advance to the Burning Blood Realm as soon as possible."
